Job Description:

Sutherland is looking for a talented Team Manager / Supervisor to support one of our growing Healthcare programs! If you have the leadership skills along with healthcare domain experience, we want to hear from you! 

As Team Manager you will get to:

  • Supervise the daily operations of the Provider Data Management team, including workload distribution, performance management, and staff development
  • Ensure provider demographic and credentialing data is accurately entered and maintained in all systems
  • Drive the performance of the team, by monitoring productivity, quality, and turnaround time standards
  • Provide day-to-day Leadership, coaching and performance management to analysts responsible for provider data maintenance and updates
  • Monitor individual and team performance metrics, identify trends and implement action plans to address productivity or quality gaps
  • Manage workflow distribution, workload prioritization, and resource allocation to meet turnaround times and operational targets. 
  • Partner with client stakeholders and internal teams, including credentialing, training, quality assurance, and operational excellence to resolve issues and improve processes
  • Manage attrition, shrinkage, and other critical metrics of the team.
  • Support projects involving system enhancements or process automation
  • Conduct regular team meetings and individual coaching sessions to communicate performance
  • Oversee the processing, validation, and maintenance of high-volume provider data submitted through bulk rosters
  • Help the team to analyze roster files to identify missing information, duplicate records, data discrepancies, and inconsistencies requiring resolution
  • Utilize Excel and other data analysis tools to manipulate, validate, reconcile and report on large volumes of provider data

 

 

Qualifications:

Our most successful candidates will have:

  • 2+ years’ experience leading a team within the healthcare domain - experience with Credentialing. (Knowledge of Claims processing or Provider data Management can be an advantage!).
  • Must be Team Manager University certified  
  • Open availability 
  • Solid Microsoft Office experience, advanced Microsoft Excel would be preferred
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to communicate complex processes clearly, adapt training approaches to different learning styles, and build a knowledgeable, high-performing team
  • The ability to be pro-active in developing trust and professional rapport with employees and team members; work as a team-player
  • Strong analytical skills; be able to interpret data, identify trends, and make suggestions for improvements
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills; be able to communicate in a clear, constructive, and professional manner

Additional Information:

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

EEOC and Veteran Documentation

job.description:
Company Description:

About Sutherland

Artificial Intelligence. Automation. Cloud engineering. Advanced analytics. For business leaders, these are key factors of success. For us, they’re our core expertise.

Sutherland
Unlocking digital performance. Delivering measurable results.

Job Description:

SCOPE OF WORK FOR LIVE UNDERWRITER ROLE

• Loan Application Review & Credit Assessment:

Review and analyze loan applications and supporting documentation including income, credit reports, employment history, and property details. Assess borrower creditworthiness using the 4 C's methodology (Character, Capacity, Capital, Collateral) to ensure sound lending decisions.

 

• Income Calculation & Financial Analysis:

Evaluate and calculate borrower income from various sources including salaried, hourly, commission, bonus, rental, and self-employment income. Analyze documents such as paystubs, W-2s, tax returns, and business financials (Schedule C, K-1, 1065, 1120S) to determine qualifying income accurately.

 

• Collateral & Property Evaluation:

Review appraisal reports, AVMs, and residential valuation documents to validate property value and ensure compliance with lending guidelines. Analyze title reports, lien positions, and ownership details.

 

• Underwriting Decision & Documentation:

Prepare detailed underwriting summaries, identify red flags, and document conditions and stipulations within the Loan Origination System (LOS), preferably Encompass. Recommend appropriate loan structures based on risk assessment.

 

• Condition Management & Borrower Follow-up:

Issue clear and comprehensive condition requests to borrowers and processors. Track condition fulfillment, verify document receipt, and manage timelines to ensure expedited loan progression toward clear-to-close status.

 

• Workflow Management & Communication:

Collaborate with processors and internal stakeholders throughout the underwriting lifecycle. Provide clear communication on loan decisions, required conditions, and final clear-to-close (CTC) status. Escalate complex issues to senior management when necessary.

 

• Risk Identification & Compliance:

Identify discrepancies, inconsistencies, and potential risks in loan files. Ensure all underwriting decisions comply with internal policies and regulatory requirements including Fair Lending, TRID, and other applicable regulations.

 

• Quality Assurance & File Review:

Conduct thorough quality reviews of underwritten files to ensure accuracy, completeness, and adherence to company standards. Identify opportunities for process improvement and best practice implementation.

 

• Reporting & Reconciliation:

Handle reconciliation of complex borrower accounts and prepare daily aging and pipeline reports to track loan progress and turnaround times. Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide metrics to management.

 

• System Utilization & Process Adherence:

Utilize LOS platforms (Encompass preferred) and adhere to underwriting workflows, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and compliance with company standards. Maintain organized file documentation and audit trails.

 

• Exception Handling & Complex Case Management:

Manage non-standard loan scenarios, unusual financial situations, and exception cases requiring enhanced analysis. Develop creative solutions while maintaining regulatory compliance and risk mitigation.

 

• Training & Knowledge Sharing:

As a senior-level associate, mentor junior underwriting staff and processors on best practices, policy updates, and complex underwriting scenarios. Contribute to team development and process documentation.

 

• Performance Metrics & KPI Tracking:

Monitor individual and team performance against established benchmarks including loan turnaround times, accuracy rates, and productivity metrics. Analyze performance data to identify trends and opportunities for continuous improvement.

 

• Regulatory Updates & Compliance Training:

Stay current with evolving lending regulations, compliance requirements, and industry updates. Participate in ongoing training and communicate regulatory changes to team members to ensure organizational compliance.

 

• Stakeholder Coordination & Escalation Management:

Coordinate with loan officers, real estate agents, appraisers, and other external stakeholders to facilitate smooth loan processing. Manage escalations and resolve conflicts professionally while maintaining positive client relationships.

 

JOB DETAILS

Company: Sutherland

Location: Navi Mumbai (Work From Home)

Experience: 2–3 Years (Live Underwriting Mandatory)

Shift: US Shift (6:30 PM – 6:30 AM | Any 9 Hours)

Week Offs: Rotational Weekly Offs

Employment Type: Full-Time

Notice Period: Immediate Joiners Preferred

 

Qualifications:

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

  • HSC and Bachelor's Degree (Mandatory)
  • Strong understanding of 4 C's of Credit
  • Expertise in income calculation (including self-employed borrowers)
  • Experience with LOS systems (Encompass preferred)
  • Good analytical and decision-making skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
  • Demonstrated experience in customer relationship management and account servicing
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in documentation
  • Knowledge of lending regulations and compliance requirements
  • Proven ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities simultaneously
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to client needs

job.title: Project Manager - Software Solutions Implementation
job.description:
Company Description:

We are One Sutherland — a global team where everyone is working together to create great breakthrough solutions. Our workforce has thrived in an environment of diversity of thought, experience and background. We celebrate our diversity and embrace it whole-heartedly. Sutherland is an equal opportunity employer. We promote a positive work environment by conducting ourselves professionally and helping each other achieve our goal of One Sutherland Team, Playing to Win.

Sutherland was founded 38 years ago (1986). Since then, we have become a leading global provider of business process and technology management services offering an integrated portfolio of analytics-driven back office and customer-facing solutions that support the entire customer life cycle.

Job Description:

Sutherland is looking for Project Managers who want to benefit from a great Onboarding program, work environment, job stability and professional growth opportunities working with multicultural teams all over the globe for one of the biggest IT Solutions multinationals in the world. The Project Manager is responsible of planning and controlling the diverse activities required to deliver projects to final customers on time, on budget, and with the required quality, despite risks and issues. Lead activities to foresee risks and issues and create the required mitigation plans. If you are looking to build a fulfilling career and are confident you have the skills and experience to help us succeed, we want to work with you!

Main Responsibilities and Deliverables Strengthen relationships:

  • End-to-end management of a project or program of projects including:
  • Scope Management
  • Time Management
  • Cost Management (budgeting, forecasting, revenue, etc.)
  • Quality Management
  • Human Resource/ Personnel Management
  • Communications Management
  • Risk Management
  • Stakeholder (internal and external) Management
  • Manage all phases of project – Initiation, Planning, Execution, Monitor and Control and Closing
  • Effective use of project management methodology, processes, tools, techniques and templates. In doing so, define project tasks and prepare project plans. Monitor, manage, and communicate project progress.
  • Manage project scope and scope changes. Manage & motivate the team assigned to the project. Provide feedback regarding their performances.
  • Being the single point of contact for assigned projects and customer representation or Business Unit in internal and external /customer forums by providing effective communication.
  • Act as a trusted adviser for assigned clients and assist with the development of roadmaps and other long range plans for leveraging the solution and maximizing the ROI.
  • Manage issues proactively, provide visibility of issues and resolution to stakeholders and escalate internally as required to resolve issues
  • Report on Status of project to internal and external stakeholders accurately on agreed frequency
  • Manage project related revenue and revenue forecast. Keep management systems updated to reflect revenue forecasting.
  • Measure the quality and efficiency of each delivery. Proactively provide feedback on lessons learned and suggestions for future improvements. Contribute to project management methodology improvements. Provide assessment of project results.
  • Be part of the broader PM community to participate, contribute, learn and collaborate to increase efficiency of Project Management at the company.

Qualifications:

Our most successful candidates will have:

  • Minimum of 5 Years of current proven experience as a PM leading teams and manage people in a matrix environment. Experience with international clients is required.
  • Experience working as a project manager for a consulting or software organization or similar delivering solutions to external clients.
  • Experience managing the full software SDLC as a project manager, including discovery, design and development of custom solutions
  • Proven Ability to manage complex and dynamic projects for external customers.
  • Proven Ability to manage large and simultaneity projects.
  • Proven experience managing IT and Software delivery projects.
  • Proven Ability to form strong customer relationships.
  • Proven Ability to span business and technical issues.
  • Ability and willingness to work in a highly dynamic environment.
  • Ability to work in a global collaborative team environment.
  • Strong business acumen and orientation.
  • Revenue forecast management.
  • Budget management.
  • PMP Certification desirable
  • Bachelor or Master’s degree in systems engineering and related fields.
  • Proficient communication skills in English.

Additional Information:

This is a Hybrid model position in Bogotá Sutherland's Facilities at Torre Krystal (Cra 7 #156-10, Usaquén)

job.title: Associate Manager - Research
job.description:
Company Description:

• Sutherland is seeking to fill a Senior High Yield Credit Analyst. As a part of the Credit Research Team, you will work with a group of investment professionals to maximize the risk/return potential of high yield investments while also collaborating with the larger Credit Research team.

• The Senior Analyst will be responsible for the credit coverage of a few major sectors and multiple individual company positions. Research delivery will include supporting primary and secondary trades while maintaining portfolio coverage on existing exposures.

• The candidate is required to have a good understanding of one or many fixed income asset classes, such as High Yield Bonds, and Leveraged Loans.

• The candidate should have prior experience towards supporting on primary and secondary deals by developing extensive financial models with multiple forecast scenario workouts and drafting of Investment Memo in an efficient and time-bound manner, together with excellent written & verbal communication skills to interact with onsite analysts and portfolio managers; which are some prerequisites for the role.

• The team works as the virtual front-end analysts for clients, helping them find value in potential investment opportunities and thereafter, monitor the investment's performance.

Job Description:

• Monitor single name corporate credit situations in North America across performing and opportunistic strategy in both leveraged loan and high yield markets

• Perform investment research, including:

• Building financial models with KPI driven Revenue models, Cost drivers, Working capital analysis, Capex schedule, Capital Structure forecast, Covenant analysis, Default & Recovery workouts and IRR sensitivities;

• Term Sheet preparation from credit agreements and bond indentures

• Drafting Investment Memos including identification of investment catalysts and provide recommendations on high yield bonds/loans, including fundamental and relative value views for primary and secondary trades

• Presenting the primary/secondary deals to the investment committee. Have full-ownership of the deal and monitoring its constant performance against benchmark bonds.

• Maintain portfolio coverage including model updates and earning summary write-ups, while maintaining regular news on the portfolio

Qualifications:

To succeed in this position, you must have:

• MBA or equivalent in Finance /CFA/CA

• Minimum of 4-5 years of buy-side or sell-side experience covering single name corporate credit in high yield markets, across Leveraged Loans and/or Bonds asset classes

• Proficiency in building extensive financials models with 3-statement forecast (all interlinked) and developing base and downside cases

• Experience in writing Investment Memos covering primary and secondary trades

• Generalist with good sector exposure in any of TMT, Healthcare, Autos, Manufacturing, Oil & Gas sectors

• Proficiency in using Databases & Portfolio Asset Management Systems- Bloomberg, CapIQ, FactSet, Syndication sites, Everest, eFront

• Ability to work under pressure and deliver high-quality research in a timely manner

job.title: Health Claims Specialists
job.description:
Company Description:

This is a full-time permanent healthcare claims adjudicator position. A claims adjudicator determines how much money will be paid after an insurance claim has been examined. This is not a customer service or customer facing position. This is a data entry position where you will be processing medical claims per the specific client requirements. Claims can vary and are highly customized depending on the service level.  You will work independently with the assistance of knowledge base and support personnel. You will also be expected to meet all Key Performance Indicators and Quality goals throughout Training and beyond.

Job Description:

What you will be doing as a Claims Examiner:

  • Work independently, processing claims via data entry for 90% of your day.
  • Be responsible for effectively adjudicating claims to meet production, quality, and other metrics in accordance with policy/procedures and regulatory guidelines
  • Follow up on claims needing additional information
  • Refer problem claims to a Lead and/or auditor for additional review
  • Make sure that the integrity of the information is accurate and kept private according to HIPPA guidelines

job.title: Lead-Research
job.description:
Company Description:

Sutherland Global Services is a process transformation company with over 30 years of experience in serving customers across industries such as BFSI, healthcare, retail, travel, telecom, and technology. Our process transformation services innovate at the intersection of business and technology to transform processes that realize our client’s vision. We are experts in accelerating performance and achieving high-impact outcomes through winning execution strategies across the entire business and customer lifecycle. Over the past three decades, we have served over 120 clients from Fortune 1000 and have attained the capability to deliver 43 million transactions a month on a digital backbone that spans 19 countries around the world.

Our research portfolio includes a host of knowledge services spanning financial research, investment research, equity research, macroeconomics research, market research, strategic research & advisory and consulting, analytics, and internal research support services. Our research practice has been built on the solid foundation laid down by the NY based Adventity Global Services, which was acquired by Sutherland in 2010. We have over a decade of experience in serving the business and strategic growth needs of 120+ multinational clients through our research and consulting services.

Job Description:

Job Description: Roles & Responsibilities

• Provide support on research assignments to address stakeholder needs.

o Understand data requirement for the engagement and determine effective data sources for the deliverable.

o Preparing insightful Industry, Company, Competitive Intelligence/Benchmarking, reports

o Ability to Identify issues, pain-points, growth opportunities for a client

 

• Designing and preparing deliverables (in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint formats)

o Conduct in-depth secondary and research, based on requirement.

o Synthesize and analyze the research findings to come up with strategic solutions/insights for the client.

o Prepare final deliverable(s)

• Build strong and relevant professional relationships internally.

• Use research tools and frameworks to develop high-impact deliverables

• Ensure the quality, timeliness, accuracy, and accountability of the assigned research projects.

• Work with moderate supervision on client deliverables and other research initiatives

• The internal research support team at Sutherland specializes in undertaking analysis, insight generation and final reporting

Qualifications:

Qualifications: Experience/ Skills Education: MBA (Marketing / Finance / Strategy / etc.) (Preferably from Tier-I/II B-School)

• 4+ years of experience in market research and consulting projects, with 2+ years of experience in delivering projects such as market entry, market opportunity assessment, market expansion strategy, new product development etc.

• Should have good customer facing capabilities.

• Strong analytical mindset

• Must be able to demonstrate the ability to understand client requirements, and the drive to go beyond stated requirements deliver best possible solutions that fulfil clients’ objectives

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• High problem-solving skills

• Strong numerical, analytical and strategic thinking skills - able to demonstrate how one supports the other - and sound commercial acumen

• Be comfortable working to tight deadlines and demanding requirements

• Driven and ability to work independently

• Flexibility to adapt to a variety of different engagement types, working hours and work environments and locations

Additional Information:

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

job.title: Insurance Operations Team Manager (Life & Disability)
job.description:
Company Description:

Artificial Intelligence. Automation. Cloud Engineering. Advanced Analytics.

At Sutherland, we help some of the world's most recognized brands transform customer experiences through innovative digital solutions, advanced technologies, and operational excellence.

With a strong focus on AI-powered transformation, automation, and customer-centric solutions, Sutherland continues to drive measurable business outcomes for global enterprises. Our people are at the center of this success, empowered to innovate, lead, and make a meaningful impact every day.

Sutherland. Digital Outcomes.

 

Job Description:

Lead. Inspire. Transform.

Are you an experienced insurance operations leader looking to take the next step in your career? Join Sutherland as a Team Manager - Life & Disability Insurance and play a pivotal role in driving operational excellence, coaching high-performing teams, and delivering exceptional customer experiences for a leading insurance program.

This is an exciting opportunity for leaders who thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy solving complex business challenges, and are passionate about developing talent while improving operational performance.

What You'll Do

  • Lead, mentor, and motivate a team to consistently achieve operational, quality, and client performance objectives.
  • Build strong relationships with clients, stakeholders, and team members to ensure business goals and service expectations are met.
  • Analyze operational data, identify trends, and develop action plans that drive productivity, quality, and customer satisfaction.
  • Coach team members through regular feedback, performance management, and career development initiatives.
  • Identify training and development opportunities to strengthen team capability and improve overall performance.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on Life and Disability Insurance processes, including:
    • Short-Term Disability (STD)
    • Long-Term Disability (LTD)
    • Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA)
    • State Leave Programs
    • Medical and insurance-related terminology
  • Ensure adherence to operational procedures, compliance requirements, and established client standards.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and business leaders to implement process improvements and operational initiatives.
  • Create a culture of accountability, engagement, continuous improvement, and customer-centricity.

 

Qualifications:

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's Degree in any field preferred, but not required.
  • At least 3 years of experience as a Team Manager or Operations Leader in a contact center environment.
  • At least 3 years of experience supporting Life Insurance and/or Disability Insurance accounts.
  • At least 3 years of experience in an Inbound Contact Center environment.
  • Strong understanding of Life Insurance, Disability Claims, STD, LTD, FMLA, and related insurance processes.
  • Proven ability to analyze performance metrics, identify opportunities, and implement effective solutions.
  • Demonstrated success in coaching, developing, and leading high-performing teams.
  • Strong stakeholder management and client-facing communication skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving, decision-making, and conflict-resolution abilities.
  • Strong organizational, multitasking, and time-management skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
  • Willingness to work onsite in Taguig City.

Additional Information:

Why Join Sutherland?

  • Join a global organization with a strong track record of innovation and growth.
  • Lead a high-impact insurance operations team supporting critical customer needs.
  • Work alongside industry professionals in a collaborative and performance-driven environment.
  • Enjoy opportunities for leadership development, career advancement, and continuous learning.
  • Be part of a company that values innovation, accountability, and employee success.

If you're a results-driven leader with a strong background in Life or Disability Insurance and a passion for developing people, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and help shape exceptional customer experiences with Sutherland.

job.title: Manager, Advanced Analytics & Data Science (Individual Contributor)
job.description:
Company Description:

Shape Business Decisions Through Data

Sutherland is seeking a highly analytical, business-minded Manager, Advanced Analytics & Data Science to join our growing Analytics organization. This is a leadership-level individual contributor role designed for a data science professional who excels at transforming complex data into strategic insights, predictive solutions, and business impact.

In this role, you will work closely with senior stakeholders, leveraging modern analytics platforms, machine learning, statistical modeling, and AI-driven techniques to solve real-world business challenges. You'll have the opportunity to influence operational efficiency, customer experience, workforce optimization, and revenue-driving strategies through advanced data science and analytics.

If you're passionate about turning data into decisions and enjoy partnering directly with leaders to solve high-impact business problems, we'd love to connect with you.

Job Description:

*For Pooling Purposes*

What You'll Do

Advanced Analytics & Business Insights

  • Perform deep-dive analyses to uncover trends, patterns, opportunities, and risks across business operations.
  • Develop descriptive, diagnostic, and predictive analytics solutions to support strategic decision-making.
  • Translate complex business questions into actionable analytical frameworks and recommendations.
  • Deliver executive-level insights through compelling storytelling, visualizations, and presentations.

Data Science & Machine Learning

  • Design, build, and deploy predictive models, including forecasting, classification, clustering, and recommendation models.
  • Apply statistical methods to identify business drivers and improve performance outcomes.
  • Evaluate model effectiveness and continuously refine solutions to maximize accuracy and business value.
  • Leverage Python, SQL, and modern analytics tools to support scalable data science initiatives.

AI, Text Analytics & Automation

  • Analyze unstructured data sources such as customer interactions, transcripts, feedback, and operational documentation.
  • Utilize Natural Language Processing (NLP) and AI-based methodologies to identify sentiment, themes, behaviors, and emerging trends.
  • Support the development of intelligent analytics solutions that enhance operational performance and customer experience.

Business Consulting & Stakeholder Management

  • Partner directly with business leaders to define requirements, align priorities, and identify opportunities for data-driven improvements.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor, helping stakeholders convert insights into measurable business actions.
  • Lead analytical discussions and effectively communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Manage multiple strategic initiatives while maintaining high-quality delivery standards.

Modern Data Platforms & Reporting

  • Work with large-scale data environments, cloud-based analytics platforms, and enterprise reporting solutions.
  • Support analytics modernization efforts by translating legacy reporting logic into scalable data solutions.
  • Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure data quality, governance, and accessibility.

Qualifications:

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • At least 4 years of experience in Data Science, Advanced Analytics, Business Analytics, or a related field.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and Python for data analysis and model development.
  • Experience building predictive and statistical models, including forecasting, regression, classification, and segmentation.
  • Solid understanding of data visualization and business intelligence concepts.
  • Experience working directly with business stakeholders and translating business challenges into analytical solutions.
  • Strong problem-solving, presentation, and communication skills.
  • Experience using Git or similar version control tools.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with cloud-based analytics platforms such as Databricks or similar technologies.
  • Knowledge of Spark SQL, PySpark, or large-scale data processing frameworks.
  • Experience in Natural Language Processing (NLP), text analytics, or AI-driven modeling.
  • Familiarity with modern machine learning frameworks and model deployment practices.
  • Exposure to optimization modeling, resource planning, workforce optimization, or operational analytics.
  • Experience supporting high-volume customer-facing, sales, service, or operations environments.

Additional Information:

Why Join Sutherland?

  • Drive high-impact analytics initiatives that influence business strategy and operational excellence.
  • Work with modern data technologies, advanced modeling techniques, and AI-powered solutions.
  • Partner directly with senior leaders and decision-makers across the organization.
  • Enjoy the autonomy and visibility of a leadership-level individual contributor role.
  • Be part of a collaborative, innovation-focused environment where your insights create measurable business value.
  • Contribute to large-scale analytics transformation programs and future-focused data strategies.

Ready to make data matter?

Join Sutherland and help shape smarter business decisions through advanced analytics, machine learning, and data-driven innovation.

Job Description:

The Occupational Health & Safety (OHS) Specialist is responsible for leading occupational health and preventive medicine initiatives while supporting the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Occupational Health and Safety Management System (SG-SST), in compliance with Colombian regulations and company policies.

With a strong focus on employee health, this role manages health surveillance programs, medical case follow-up, medical absenteeism monitoring, and interventions aimed at preventing illness, reducing health-related risks, and supporting employees’ ability to work safely.

The OHS Specialist partners closely with Operations, HR, Facilities, medical providers, EPS, and ARL to address employee health needs and promote a healthy, safe, and productive work environment within a fast-paced Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) operation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead preventive medicine and occupational health initiatives focused on early detection, disease prevention, and employee wellbeing.
  • Coordinate health surveillance programs (PVE), occupational medical evaluations, and follow-up on medical recommendations.
  • Manage medical case follow-up, absenteeism monitoring, medical restrictions, workplace accommodations, and return-to-work plans in coordination with HR, EPS, ARL, and medical providers.
  • Implement programs addressing musculoskeletal, ergonomic, cardiovascular, visual, and psychosocial risks.
  • Analyze health and absenteeism indicators to identify trends, prioritize interventions, and evaluate program effectiveness.
  • Support the implementation and continuous improvement of the SG-SST, ensuring compliance with Colombian regulations and company standards.
  • Conduct workplace assessments, support incident investigations and audits, and monitor corrective and preventive actions.
  • Deliver health promotion campaigns and OHS training, and support emergency preparedness activities.

Qualifications:

Required

  • 3+ years of experience in Occupational Health & Safety.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a health-related field (e.g., Nursing, Physiotherapy, or Occupational Therapy).
  • Valid Colombian Occupational Health & Safety license.
  • Current SG-SST certification (50-hour course and applicable updates).
  • Active RETHUS registration.
  • Experience in preventive medicine follow-up, medical case management, and monitoring medical absenteeism.
  • B1 High or above English proficiency.

Desirable

  • Experience in BPO, Contact Center, Shared Services, or high-volume service environments.
  • Handling data analytics tools, such as Power-BI.
  • Experience managing programs related to psychosocial risk, absenteeism, ergonomics, and employee wellbeing. 

Key Competencies

  • Problem-solving and decision-making
  • Project management

Job Description:

You will be the primary interface between the Customers and NICE’s support organizations while managing critical issues, problems and requests related to escalations and missed expectations.

job.title: Senior Manager, Financial Fraud Analytics & Risk Strategy (Individual Contributor)
job.description:
Company Description:

Protect the Business. Influence Decisions. Drive Fraud Prevention Strategy.

Sutherland is seeking a highly analytical and business-minded Senior Manager, Financial Fraud Analytics & Risk Strategy to lead the development of data-driven fraud prevention and risk mitigation initiatives. This is a senior-level individual contributor role designed for professionals who excel at solving complex fraud challenges, uncovering emerging risk patterns, and influencing enterprise-wide decisions through advanced analytics and strategic insights.

As a trusted advisor to business and operational leaders, you will leverage data, technology, and investigative methodologies to identify fraud trends, improve risk controls, strengthen compliance frameworks, and drive measurable business outcomes. You will play a critical role in protecting revenue, enhancing customer trust, and ensuring operational integrity across the organization.

This role is ideal for professionals with experience in fraud risk management, financial crime analytics, banking operations, payment risk, consulting, or enterprise risk functions.

Job Description:

*For Pooling Purposes*

What You'll Do

Lead Fraud Analytics & Risk Strategy

  • Develop and execute data-driven strategies to identify, monitor, and mitigate financial fraud risks.
  • Analyze fraud trends, emerging threats, and operational vulnerabilities to proactively recommend risk reduction initiatives.
  • Partner with senior leaders to align fraud prevention strategies with broader business objectives.

Drive Complex Investigations & Root Cause Analysis

  • Lead deep-dive analyses into fraud incidents, behavioral patterns, and risk events.
  • Identify root causes and recommend sustainable solutions to strengthen controls and reduce future exposure.
  • Assess new fraud tactics and emerging external threats to ensure organizational readiness.

Deliver Actionable Business Intelligence

  • Utilize advanced analytics to uncover fraud patterns, anomalies, and operational risks.
  • Develop predictive models, dashboards, and reporting frameworks that support informed decision-making.
  • Translate complex findings into concise, executive-level recommendations and actionable strategies.

Strengthen Risk Controls & Operational Effectiveness

  • Evaluate existing fraud controls, monitoring systems, and operational processes.
  • Recommend enhancements that improve detection rates, reduce losses, and increase operational efficiency.
  • Support the implementation of automation, process improvements, and advanced fraud management solutions.

Influence Executive Decision-Making

  • Serve as a subject matter expert and strategic advisor for fraud risk management initiatives.
  • Present trends, risks, opportunities, and recommendations to senior leadership and key stakeholders.
  • Lead high-priority projects and analyses that support organizational risk management objectives.

Qualifications:

What We're Looking For

Strategic Risk Thinking

You can quickly assess complex fraud environments, identify key risk drivers, and develop practical strategies that balance customer experience, operational efficiency, and risk mitigation.

Advanced Analytical Capability

You are highly proficient in translating large, complex datasets into meaningful business insights and actionable recommendations.

Executive Presence & Influencing Skills

You can communicate technical findings clearly to both operational teams and executive stakeholders, enabling confident decision-making.

Independent Leadership

You thrive in ambiguity, take ownership of critical initiatives, and drive results without requiring direct management responsibility.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Criminology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 8+ years of experience in Financial Fraud, Risk Management, Fraud Analytics, Financial Crime, Banking Operations, Payments Risk, Compliance, Investigations, or related fields.
  • Proven experience developing fraud detection, monitoring, and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills with experience working with large datasets and complex business problems.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and data analysis tools.
  • Experience using SQL, Python, R, SAS, Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytics platforms is highly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of fraud typologies, transaction monitoring, investigative techniques, and risk management frameworks.
  • Experience partnering with senior stakeholders and influencing cross-functional business decisions.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Relevant certifications such as CFE, CAMS, CRCM, CFCS, or similar credentials are advantageous.

Additional Information:

Why Join Sutherland?

At Sutherland, you'll have the opportunity to solve sophisticated fraud and risk challenges, partner with senior leaders, and help shape strategies that protect the business while driving operational excellence. Your expertise will directly influence critical decisions and contribute to a secure, resilient, and high-performing organization.

If you're passionate about fraud prevention, advanced analytics, and strategic problem-solving, we invite you to apply and make a lasting impact.

job.title: Wellness Director
job.description:
Company Description:

Job summary:

The primary role of the Wellness Lead is to foster a culture of wellbeing by designing, implementing, and continuously enhancing a comprehensive wellness program that integrates wellbeing into everyday work life and elevates the overall employee experience.

Through this program, the Wellness Lead promotes awareness of holistic wellbeing, helps employees recognize the early signs of physical and mental ill health, supports the adoption of preventive practices, and ensures employees have access to appropriate resources and support services.

Key stakeholders include people leaders and employees. The program equips managers with the knowledge, skills, and confidence to support the wellbeing of their teams, while encouraging employees to take personal ownership of their health and wellbeing journey. The ultimate objectives are to raise awareness, strengthen manager capability, enhance employee wellbeing, improve engagement, and contribute to a positive and healthy workplace culture.

The program adopts a holistic approach, addressing the habits, environments, relationships, and workplace factors that influence overall wellbeing across all dimensions of wellness. It considers both preventative and proactive strategies that support sustainable physical, mental, social, emotional, financial, and occupational wellbeing.

The scope of the wellness program extends across both office-based and remote working environments, ensuring equitable access to wellbeing support regardless of where employees work.

Job Description:

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Create innovative and effective wellness programs and interventions to encourage positive lifestyle choices and or make recommendations for changes in personal habits;
  • Create awareness of wellness resources and materials that lead to self-development
  • Set up a community of wellness champions/first aiders;
  • Use data to continually evaluate the quality and effectiveness of programs;
  • Provide sessions for People leaders to help them support their teams and approach the topic of wellbeing with confidence;
  • Facilitate training sessions on wellness topics including but not limited to resilience and wellbeing, stress management, nutrition, weight management, physical fitness, work life balance;
  • Create and administer surveys to gather data and employee feedback. Analyze the results and make recommendations for actions;
  • Communicate with internal and external stakeholders on the wellness program, its implementation and effectiveness using data and reports;
  • Collaborate with wellness partners/vendors to ensure high-quality products and services are delivered and well-utilized;
  • Undertakes risk analyses and makes recommendations to for changes and ensuring regulatory compliance (wherever applicable)

Qualifications:

Job qualifications:

  • Graduate degree, Diploma or higher in clinical psychology, counseling, health psychology, or related health field; Or Experience leading this function
  • Qualified counsellor and/or psychotherapist; and supervision qualification is a plus.
  • Experience as a wellness coach in a corporate setting preferred;
  • A high degree of empathy and sensitivity;
  • Excellent interpersonal communication skills;
  • Active listening skills;
  • Confidently talks about wellness issues;
  • Can adapt counseling/coaching style to the situation;
  • Possess a high degree of integrity, trusted to maintain confidentiality;
  • Experience with metric management and reporting;
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills;
  • Ability to work collaboratively and independently.

Basic regulations, which the employee should be aware of:

  • The employee handbook;
  • Labor health and safety rules and policies;
  • Wellness policy;
  • Other internal policies and procedures of the company.

Additional Information:

Interested candidates must be willing to work onsite in Clark, Pampanga

We are One Sutherland — a global team where everyone is working together to create great breakthrough solutions. Our workforce has thrived in an environment of diversity of thought, experience and background. We celebrate our diversity and embrace it whole-heartedly. Sutherland is an equal opportunity employer. We promote a positive work environment by conducting ourselves professionally and helping each other achieve our goal of One Sutherland Team, Playing to Win.

Sutherland was founded 35 years ago (1986). Since then, we have become a leading global provider of business process and technology management services offering an integrated portfolio of analytics-driven back office and customer-facing solutions that support the entire customer life cycle.

Job Description:

Are you an excellent verbal and written communicator, and a great listener? Do you thrive on a team that's focused on finding the best solutions for customers? Can you remain kind and supportive when customers share their concerns about their loan? Do you have prior collections, sales or customer service experience?

We are seeking a motivated and passionate Auto Loan Collections Advisor to join us! If you are looking to build a fulfilling career, and the description above resonates with you, we want to work with you!

Essential Duties in this role:

Associates should educate customers on account status, attempting to solve customer problems and/or attempting to secure a payment or make payment arrangements. The goal is to help our customers build and retain a strong credit standing and maintain a customer for life.
  • Provide excellent customer service to customers who need assistance in meeting their contract obligations due to unexpected financial obligations.
  • Contact or attempt contact with customers who are delinquent.
  • Overcome objections that customers have about making payments toward their account and help them to understand their account(s) and responsibilities.
  • Maintain positive working relationships with the Loan Servicing team. 
  • Meet or exceed production goals

What Kind of Associates Are We Looking for?

  • Agile in a fast-past environment.
  • You embody excellent customer service.
  • Team oriented and people-oriented.
  • Critical thinker and quick learner.
  • Has good active listening skills.

  • Passionate and goal-oriented
  • Positive emotional resilience and emotional intelligence.
  • Must be self-motivated with strong decision-making and problem solving abilities
  • Flexible and committed to overall goals.

Qualifications:

Our most successful candidates will have: - 

  • Must be 18 years and older.

I, II, III; GCE A, B, C; SSC 4, 5; JSCE Pass; NCTVET Level 1, 2, 3; and CCSLC Competence & Mastery).

Job Description:

Sutherland Global Services is seeking a Subject Matter Expert with 5+ years of experience in implementing translation and localization platforms for enterprise clients. As a Subject Matter Expert, you'll be the implementation specialist who lands the platform inside the client's organization, supporting the rollout, user onboarding, training, and adoption work that turns a deployed system into an operational service. You'll run the discovery sessions that capture how the client's translation operations actually work today, map their existing content, glossaries, and Translation Memory assets onto the platform, train each user role on the workflow they handle, and stay close to users through ongoing support to drive adoption, resolve operational questions, and feed real usage patterns back into the team.

Responsibilities:

  • Run discovery and requirements workshops with client stakeholders to capture the as-is translation operation and define the to-be workflow on the platform.
  • Configure the platform for the client's operating model, including service tiers, glossaries, Translation Memory imports, language pairs, user roles, and approval routing.
  • Migrate the client's existing translation assets including glossaries, Translation Memory, style guides, and reference content into the platform.
  • Deliver role-based user training for Requesters, Reviewers, Approvers, and Administrators, including live sessions, recorded walkthroughs, and quick-reference materials.
  • Author end-user documentation and operating procedures for each platform role, including screenshots and walkthroughs captured from the running portal.
  • Drive user adoption through hands-on enablement, office-hours sessions, and follow-up with users who have stalled in the workflow.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for client business users during ongoing support, handling functional questions, change requests, and operational escalations.
  • Translate user feedback and operational patterns into clear, actionable requirements for developers, QA, and ML engineers.
  • Validate that new releases match the client's operating expectations through user acceptance testing alongside client stakeholders.
  • Coordinate change management activities including release communications, training refreshers, and adoption metrics reporting.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into clear, implementable specifications.

Qualifications:

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Mass Communication, or a related field. MBA with a Project Management specialization, or PMP / PRINCE2 certification, is a strong plus.
  • 5+ years of experience implementing translation, localization, or content workflow platforms for enterprise clients, with direct responsibility for rollout, training, and adoption.
  • Hands-on experience configuring and operating Translation Management Systems, CAT tools, or equivalent localization platforms.
  • Working knowledge of Translation Memory concepts, glossary management, fuzzy matching, and post-editing workflows.
  • Familiarity with industry-standard localization formats including TMX, SDLTM, XLIFF, CSV, and Excel for asset migration.
  • Familiarity with industry standards including ISO 17100 and ISO 18587 as they apply to client operations.
  • Experience designing and delivering end-user training for non-technical business users.
  • Experience writing user-facing documentation, operating procedures, and quick-reference materials.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to navigate client organizations and build trust with business users.
  • Strong written and verbal communication for training delivery, user-facing documentation, and client working sessions.
  • Strong organizational and follow-through skills with a track record of driving adoption through to steady-state usage.
  • Experience with regulated-industry document workflows, change management certifications, or prior implementation work on healthcare or banking content programs would be advantageous.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

job.title: Lead Databricks Architect – Financial Services & Banking
job.description:
Company Description:

About Sutherland: 

At Sutherland Healthcare Solutions, we’re transforming how we work by harnessing the power of AI, data, and digital innovation to accelerate the discovery and development of life-saving therapies. Our vision is to embed artificial intelligence and advanced analytics across every stage of our scientific and operational workflows—empowering our teams with smarter tools, seamless data, and actionable insights to deliver client-centric services and solutions that better serve our customers and, ultimately, improve patients’ lives.

Job Description:

Sutherland is seeking an experienced Lead Databricks Architect with deep domain expertise in the banking and financial services industry to drive the strategy, design, and implementation of our enterprise lakehouse platform.
In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex banking business requirements and cutting-edge data architecture. You will be responsible for building a secure, scalable, and highly performant Databricks lakehouse environment that powers critical banking applications, including regulatory reporting, risk management, fraud detection, customer analytics, and real-time transaction processing.

Key Responsibilities
Architecture & Platform Strategy

  • Design and implement an enterprise-grade Databricks Lakehouse architecture leveraging Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Databricks SQL tailored for financial data models.
  • Establish architectural patterns for high-throughput batch and real-time streaming data pipelines (e.g., Structured Streaming, Auto Loader) integrating core banking systems, payment gateways, and third-party data providers.
  • Drive the migration strategy from legacy data warehouses (e.g., Teradata, Oracle, Snowflake, mainframe environments) to Databricks.
     

Security, Compliance & Governance

  • Implement strict data security, enterprise access controls, and fine-grained permissions using Databricks Unity Catalog to comply with financial regulations (e.g., GDPR, SOX, PCI-DSS).
  • Architect data masking, tokenization, and encryption strategies for Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and Sensitive Personal Data (SPD).
  • Ensure full data lineage, auditing, and metadata management across multi-cloud or hybrid-cloud deployment environments (Azure).

Data Engineering & Performance Optimization

  • Define best practices for PySpark, Delta Live Tables (DLT), and SQL optimization to maximize compute efficiency and reduce total cost of ownership (TCO).
  • Establish CI/CD, DevOps, and MLOps automation frameworks for code deployment, data quality validation (e.g., Great Expectations), and model lifecycle management.
  • Partner with Data Science, Quantitative Analytics, and BI teams to support advanced financial modeling, predictive risk analysis, and customer 360 initiatives.
     

Stakeholder & Domain Leadership

  • Collaborate with business leaders, Chief Risk Officers (CROs), and compliance teams to align data platform capabilities with core banking business objectives.

Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and architecture governance to data engineering and analytics teams.
 

Qualifications:

Required Technical Skills

  • Databricks Expertise: 5+ years of hands-on experience designing and running large-scale Databricks environments in production.
  • Cloud Architecture: Deep knowledge of AWS, Azure, or GCP data services (e.g., Azure Data Lake Storage/Data Factory, AWS S3/Glue, or GCP GCS/BigQuery).
  • Data Processing & Storage: Mastery of Delta Lake, PySpark, Databricks SQL, Structured Streaming, and Delta Live Tables.
  • Governance & Security: Strong hands-on experience configuring Databricks Unity Catalog, RBAC, ABAC, and data governance frameworks.
  • DevOps & Infrastructure as Code: Proficiency with Terraform, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins), and Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs).
     

Required Banking Domain Knowledge

  • Domain Experience: 3+ years working within a retail bank, investment bank, or financial services institution.
  • Financial Data Models: Familiarity with core banking operations, payments, lending, credit risk, anti-money laundering (AML), or fraud data structures.
  • Regulatory Landscape: Strong understanding of banking data compliance requirements, auditability, and data sovereignty standards.
     

Education & Certifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Certifications (Preferred):
    Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional
    Cloud Solutions Architect Certification (AWS Certified Solutions Architect / Azure Solutions Architect Expert)

Additional Information:

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

EEOC and Veteran Documentation
During employment, employees are treated without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, marital or veteran status, medical condition or handicap, or any other legally protected status.
At times, government agencies require periodic reports from employers on the sex, ethnicity, handicap, veteran and other protected status of employees. The purpose of this Administrative EEO Record is for statistical analysis only and is used to comply with government record keeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Periodic reports are made to the government on the following information. The completion of the Administrative EEO record is optional. If you choose to volunteer the requested information, please note that all 
Administrative EEO Records are kept in a Confidential File and are not part of your Application for Employment or Personnel file.
Please note: YOUR COOPERATION IS VOLUNTARY. INCLUSION OR EXCLUSION OF ANY DATA WILL NOT AFFECT ANY EMPLOYMENT DECISION.

job.description:
Company Description:

About Sutherland: 

Artificial Intelligence. Automation. Cloud engineering. Advanced analytics. For business leaders, these are key factors of success. For us, they’re our core expertise.

We work with iconic brands worldwide. We bring them a unique value proposition through market-leading technology and business process excellence.

We’ve created over 200 unique inventions under several patents across AI and other critical technologies. Leveraging our advanced products and platforms, we drive digital transformation, optimize critical business operations, reinvent experiences, and pioneer new solutions, all provided through a seamless “as a service” model.

For each company, we provide new keys for their businesses, the people they work with, and the customers they serve. We tailor proven and rapid formulas, to fit their unique DNA. We bring together human expertise and artificial intelligence to develop digital chemistry. This unlocks new possibilities, transformative outcomes and enduring relationships.

Sutherland

Unlocking digital performance. Delivering measurable results

Job Description:

Sutherland is seeking a talented onsite IT Help Desk Specialist to join our growing team in Cairo! If you have the skills and experience needed to succeed in this role, we want to hear from you! 

As an IT Help Desk Specialist, you'll be responsible for the following:

Technical Support:

  • Provides technical support to users by researching and answering questions, troubleshooting problems, and maintaining workstation and LAN performance.
  • Efficient problem resolution and maximize systems availability.
  • Review the frequently faced system problems and work on the improvements.
  • Strict Compliance to agreed SLA for issue resolution.
  • On Call 24x7.
  • Maintains integrity of systems.
  • Ensure all users can access their workstation with required privileges for day-to-day operations.
  • Interacts with internal clients on all levels to help resolve IT-related issues and provides answers in a timely manner. This includes Relationship Management, Communications, Meetings, and floor walks. Working with them and prioritizing helpdesk tickets response and face to face follow-up with internal customers to drive Service Level Agreements.
  • Participates in problem management and promptly escalates faults in line with set procedures to the correct support agency and resolves the problem in a timely manner without affecting Business. This includes collection of info and monitors on frequently occurring problems and reports these issues to the relevant groups in order to resolve them, and ensures all of these are made known to the Management team (Duty Manager, Site Lead, Site Manager).
  • Daily system maintenance checks prior to the operation/business opening hours, with ongoing support during operational hours.
  • Performs routine preventive maintenance on hardware and software, to include desktops, laptops, copiers, faxes, scanners, telephones, bar-code scanners, thin clients and other technologies.
  • Strictly adhere to the set procedures and follow the guidelines.

Hardware/software preparation & installations:

  • Responsible for preparing, deploying and installing all IT assets including desktops, laptops, monitors, copiers, faxes, scanners, telephones, thin clients, windows operating systems & applications, switches, routers, etc.

Documentation:

  • Maintaining a documentation for all IT assets, network changes/activities, including creation and maintains for all system related manuals and guides.
  • Documentation maintained to support compliance/IT Security and audit requirements.
  • Improves client references by writing and maintaining documentation.
  • Participates in Asset management. Ensure Assets are maintained and tracked accordingly by following the Standard Operating Procedures for such.

 

Qualifications:

• Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering/ Computer Science, Electronics and Communications Engineering or equivalent.

• MCSE, MCITP, CCNA knowledge with minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in windows operating systems & Cisco network environments. Certification is a plus.

• Technical experience & awareness with Windows Operating Systems, Active Directory, Virtualization technologies, SCCM, switching, routing, Voice over IP and IP technologies, Antivirus systems, etc.

Previous BPO Experience 

• Familiar with standard concepts, practices, and procedures within information technology.

• Ability to work well with others in pursuit of business aims / ability to work under pressure.

• Energy, enthusiasm and commitment to the business unit.

• Positive response to and recognition of the need for change.

• Ability to make realistic decisions and is willing to take the responsibility for acting on their own initiative.

• High standards of integrity and the ability to motivate self/others towards continuous performance improvement and personal development.

• Willing to work on different shifts and be assigned to other sites/location if required.

Additional Information:

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

job.description:
Company Description:

We are One Sutherland — a global team where everyone is working together to create great breakthrough solutions. Our workforce has thrived in an environment of diversity of thought, experience and background. We celebrate our diversity and embrace it whole-heartedly. Sutherland is an equal opportunity employer. We promote a positive work environment by conducting ourselves professionally and helping each other achieve our goal of One Sutherland Team, Playing to Win.

Sutherland was founded 35 years ago (1986). Since then, we have become a leading global provider of business process and technology management services offering an integrated portfolio of analytics-driven back office and customer-facing solutions that support the entire customer life cycle.

Job Description:

Sutherland is seeking an analytical and attentive person to join us as an Insurance Transaction Associate. We are a group of driven and hard-working individuals. If you are looking to build a fulfilling career and are confident you have the skills and experience to help us succeed, we want to work with you!

Enthusiastic and self-motivated Customer Service Associates in this role get to provide support service for our insurance customers. Insurance Transaction Customer Service Associates at Sutherland:

* Build good working relationships and establish rapport with customers to gain trust and understanding

* Convey actions taken on insurance policies accurately and clearly to customers

* Maintain and improve quality results by adhering to established standards and guidelines

* Update job knowledge by studying new product descriptions and participate in educational opportunities

* Collaborate with licensed insurance agents to provide quality customer care and resolve complex issues

* Manage communications by diligently tracking and recording outcomes of customer calls/online chats/emails to ensure timely responses

* Review job aids and effectively communicate with team members to gather all required data necessary for resolution to service requests

* Explain insurance products, processes, and policy details to customers in a clear and concise manner

* Process policy changes, including updates to coverage, beneficiaries, and personal information

* Handle billing inquiries and assist customers with premium payments or payment arrangements

* Identify cross-selling and upselling opportunities when appropriate, referring customers to licensed agents for further assistance

* Maintain customer confidentiality and adhere to all company and industry compliance standards

* Utilize various software systems and databases to access and update customer information efficiently

* Participate in team meetings and contribute ideas for process improvements and enhanced customer satisfaction

* Adapt to changing policies, procedures, and technologies in the insurance industry to provide up-to-date and accurate information to customers

Qualifications:

Our most successful candidates will have: - 

  • Must be 18 years or older.
  •  A minimum of 3-4 CXC/GCE/City & Guilds subjects inclusive of English Language, or a U.S. high school diploma or GED. CXC/CSEC, City & Guilds. I, II, III; GCE A, B, C; SSC 4, 5; JSCE Pass; NCTVET or HEART Level 1, 2, 3; and CCSLC - Competence & Mastery. ( Must have proof of qualifications)
  • Prior Healthcare/Insurance experience preferred.
  • Must have a valid (not expired) government issued ID, TRN and NIS card.
  • Must be able to pass a criminal background check and drug test as needed.
  • Must have flexible availability to work any day and any assigned shift weekly.(Weekends and Public Holidays).
  • Must be able to train and / or work onsite at our Red Hills Road site.
  • Must have flexibility to return to site as required by the business.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform at a high level, to support our high volume of inbound calls.
  • Experience in customer service is an asset and preferred.
  • Good systematic problem solving ability , using sound business judgment, and following through on commitments to customers.
  • The ability to quickly and accurately identify and assess individual customer needs and take appropriate action steps to satisfy those needs.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • See through the eyes of the customer.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to translate Customer communication rapidly and effectively on live voice or chat interactions. proficient reading skills required.
  • The ability to project patience, empathy, caring, and sincerity in written words or voice tone, depending on channel.
  • Ability to effectively organize, prioritize, multi-task and manage time.
  • Multi-tasking skills, showcased through the use of several applications; experience working with CRM applications preferred.
  • Basic PC keyboarding skills; basic Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel) experience required.
  • Ability to type over 30 WPM with 80% accuracy.
  • Must be very tech savvy with strong abilities in handling troubleshooting techniques and resolving technical issues.
  • Inspire confidence and positively influence the behaviour, actions, and thoughts of others.
  • Must be able to pass a criminal background check and drug test as needed.

Additional Information:

Our employees enjoy:

  • Competitive compensation packages inclusive of base pay, incentives, over-time and shift differentials for certain shifts.
  • Annual merit increase based on performance.
  • Paid Training.
  • Discounts for several corporate and retail partners for services and products once Sutherland ID is presented.
  • Excellent training and supervisory support - to help you feel comfortable servicing our customers.
  • Competitive Salary with attractive and attainable PBI structure.
  • Paid vacation and sick leave annually.
  • Exceptional Health and Life Insurance Plan
  • Lunch benefits and subsidy.
  • Onsite lunch concessionaire at reduced rates.
  • Transportation/ Shuttle Services - Free transportation home for shifts that end after 9:00 pm and pick-ups for shifts that begin before 6am
  • Free On-site medical suite with nurse and medical doctor.
  • Daily Refuel Plan - Robust and dynamic schedule of activities to keep employees energized both at home and in the office.
  • Paid referral program
  • Career development & growth opportunities for advancement.
  • Excellent Reward and recognition programs.

Job Description:

Large e-Commerce Furniture Marketplace seeking candidate that will act as a liaison, provide services information, answer questions, and resolve any emerging problems that our clients' accounts might face with accuracy and efficiency. Candidate should be genuinely excited to help clients. You must be patient, empathetic, and passionately communicative. The target is to ensure excellent service standards, respond efficiently to clients inquiries and maintain high customer satisfaction. These customers are based in North America.

Responsibilities

  • Identify and assess clients’ needs to achieve satisfaction
  • Build sustainable relationships and trust with customer accounts through open and interactive communication
  • Provide accurate, valid and complete information by using the right methods/tools
  • Meet personal/customer service team sales targets and call handling quotas
  • Handle customer complaints, provide appropriate solutions and alternatives within the time limits; follow up to ensure resolution
  • Keep records of customer interactions, process customer accounts and file documents
  • Follow communication procedures, guidelines and policies
  • Take the extra mile to engage clients

What Does Service Representative Do?

  • Demonstrate Reliability: Attendance and commitment to being present and on time for your full shift each day is crucial. This helps ensure we're ready and available to help our customers when they need us most. For unexpected events or issues, we require our representatives to be proactive in their communication and planning whenever possible.
  • Handle a High Volume of Contacts
  • Meet Our High Performance Bar: You’ll work to exceed customer satisfaction, excel in meeting customer service efficiency metrics, and other responsibilities as assigned. 
  • Engage Customers: You’ll need a passion for people. You'll be the voice of Wayfair and work to build a relationship with customers who contact us by inbound phone call, chats, and emails. Topics can range from returns, replacements, delivery, product availability, order status, and more. 
  • Listen Actively and Show Empathy: You will actively listen to understand customer concerns and leverage internal resources to find the best solution to thoroughly address their problem.
  • De-Escalate Customer Concerns: Most customers contact us because they’ve had a problem and need your help. You will use your conflict management skills to balance the needs of the customer with the options from the business while always maintaining a professional composure.
  • Problem Solve: Solutions aren’t a one-size-fits-all approach so customer service representatives do not read from pre-populated scripts. You will be given a level of autonomy to help customers find the right solution. You’ll need to think analytically to solve customer problems in a first contact resolution approach.
  • Multitask: You’ll need to juggle navigating multiple browsers, tabs, tools, and screens in order to quickly and effectively answer questions. The ideal customer service representative will be familiar with computers and can effectively navigate technology on a daily basis.
  • Escalate Systemic Issues: Help us continuously improve. You’ll identify areas where improvement is needed on behalf of their customers and share any trends with leadership.

With operations across multiple countries, we provide customer experience, back-office, digital, and consulting services to some of the world's leading brands.

Job Description:

Sutherland is seeking a Senior Team Manager to lead a Mortgage Communication Desk team responsible for delivering timely, accurate, and professional support throughout the loan lifecycle. This role serves as the operational lead for communication-related activities, ensuring exceptional customer experience, strong stakeholder engagement, and consistent achievement of service-level targets.

job.title: Software Implementation Engineer - VoIP, SIP, Networking, Windows Server
job.description:
Company Description:

We are One Sutherland — a global team where everyone is working together to create great breakthrough solutions. Our workforce has thrived in an environment of diversity of thought, experience and background. We celebrate our diversity and embrace it whole-heartedly. Sutherland is an equal opportunity employer. We promote a positive work environment by conducting ourselves professionally and helping each other achieve our goal of One Sutherland Team, Playing to Win.

Sutherland was founded 38 years ago (1986). Since then, we have become a leading global provider of business process and technology management services offering an integrated portfolio of analytics-driven back office and customer-facing solutions that support the entire customer life cycle.

Job Description:

We are seeking for an Implementation Engineer with 5-10 years of experience to join our Delivery and Engineering team as NTR-x Professional Services Engineers (PSE). The role is responsible for the remote installation, implementation, configuration, and integration of the NiCE NTR-x platform, and for delivering enterprise-scale recording and compliance solutions to leading banks and financial institutions. The PSE provides technical expertise across the full project lifecycle, from the sales-to-services transition through project closure, working with Architects, Project Managers, R&D, Customer Support, and clients.

Key Responsibilities

  • Install, integrate, and configure the NiCE NTR-x recording solution remotely, following defined methodology, enterprise standards, system requirements, and customer-specific needs.
  • Develop and configure software features in line with design specifications and customer requirements; ensure all components of the technical architecture are properly integrated and implemented.
  • Plan and execute unit, functional, and system testing; support client UAT, data validation, and solution verification activities.
  • Assist customers and their vendors with configuration requirements for all NiCE integration points in the customer environment.
  • Provide technical expertise across the NiCE product suite (solution design, technical support, quality assurance, and application overview) throughout every project stage.
  • Report and escalate implementation issues appropriately; engage Support, R&D, and management for higher-tier assistance when required.
  • Maintain regular, proactive communication with customers and management on progress, risks, and technical updates.
  • Support after-hours, weekend, client-site, and cross-time-zone activities as required by project demands.
  • Communicate customer technical feedback to R&D and Product Support to drive product enhancements and fixes.

Qualifications:

Mandatory Skills/Experience:

  • Experience in the Financial Services / Banking domain.
  • Hands-on experience with NiCE or other recording solutions (e.g., Verint): installation, configuration, upgrades, and maintenance on Windows and cloud platforms.
  • Microsoft Windows Server / OS knowledge.
  • IP / SIP communication analysis and a strong telephony background.
  • Networking fundamentals: 7-layer OSI model, TCP, UDP, LAN/WAN, NICs, switches, and routers. Senior Professional Services Engineer (NTR-x) 
  • Troubleshooting with sniffers and analysis tools such as Wireshark, log analysis, and other network-testing utilities.
  • Basic scripting: query and update knowledge (SQL / shell).
  • Strong customer-facing skills: able to lead technical discussions, manage stakeholder engagement, and represent NiCE in client meetings.

 

Good to have:

  • Telephony & Integration: Recording / telephony integration experience with PBX, switch, and ACD vendors, including Avaya, Cisco, Microsoft Teams, and Amazon Connect.
  • Cloud & Virtualization: Cloud experience with AWS (primary) and Azure. • Virtualization on VMware and Citrix.
  • Advanced Solutions: MDC, LDAP, SSO, and ACD integrations. • Database migrations. • Disaster Recovery and High-Availability designs.
  • Microsoft Security: Active Directory, Domain Controllers, Group Policy, and DNS. • Security policies, hardening, and encryption. • Certificate Authority and EFS.

Added Advantage:

  • Certifications: MCP / MCSE, CCNA, VMware, Citrix, AWS, Azure.
  • ​​​​​​​Microsoft SQL Server (2012 and above): installation, configuration, administration, backup, recovery, and maintenance

Additional Information:

This is a hybrid position in Usaquén, Bogotá, Colombia (North Point, Torre Krystal Building: Cra 7 #156-10)
