Job Description:

Sutherland is looking for a Sr. Director Network Administration (Remote - US Base). This role is responsible for overseeing and managing the Americas region’s network strategy, design, operation, and improvement of corporate and cloud networks for all of Sutherlands Business Units. This individual will manage a team of network engineers in our Americas region and be accountable for the design, management, upgrade, implementation strategy and stability of our wireless/wired networks, firewalls, switches, and cloud environment.  Accountability extends to maintaining our network security which includes the definition, reporting, and documentation of our network architecture and compliance with peer standards in our other regions.

This individual will partner with our Global Network Teams, Server teams and other IT organizations as required to perform associated duties.  This position will also work with our vendors and Business team members to design and deliver network services to support and enable Sutherland Business units and its clients. This includes proactive scanning, preventative maintenance, troubleshooting, managing hardware/software upgrades, Information Security Management as it relates to network infrastructure and actioning urgent response requirements as needed.

Responsibilities:

 Senior Director of Network Services summary of job function:

  • Network Security, LAN, WAN, and Wireless architecture design and implementation for all Sutherland Network Operations support for APAC region.
  • Provide management and technical direction for team of network engineers.
  • Ensure the network meets availability, reliability, security, and performance requirements.
  • Research and define network hardware and software standards with peers for Sutherland Network.
  • Develop/Update network related policies, procedures and processes.
  • Standardize network configuration across all Americas regions.

Management and Development of Network Operation Strategy

  • Develop and Manage network designs and build from multiple infrastructure projects to ensure appropriate delivery, reliability, redundancy, safety, security, scalability, and sustainability with contingency planning for growth design strategies for Sutherland.
  • Develop, Design, Manage and build of New/Remodeled Sutherland facilities.
  • Manage network engineering team.
  • Develop and oversee network technology roadmap for all Americas regions.
  • Collaborate with business units on strategic technical solutions.
  • Provide Level 3 network support for all Americas Region.
  • Maintain security across network infrastructure in conjunction with the Info Security Team and the Network Security Architecture team.
  • Develop and Maintain all network documentation as changes are implemented.
  • Work with VP of Global Network Services on Budgeting, Forecast planning and Special Project ROI Models.
  • Good technical expertise with enterprise On Prem Network Technologies – Switches, Routers, Load Balancers, Network Access Control, Remote Access technologies, SDWAN Devices, Wireless Networks, Web Proxy Services, as well as the supporting technologies like DNS and DHCP.
  • Participate in IT change control process and provide notifications to the business partners/stakeholders of planned and/or unplanned changes, maintenance windows, and outages.
  • Stay abreast of current technologies, developments, network compliance requirements, standards, and industry trends.
  • Ability to be on call as needed, accommodate intermittent travel, and perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

Education/Certifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree, required in Computer Science, Engineering or related field.
  • Master’s degree, preferred in Computer Science, Business Management, or related field.
  • Minimum of five (5) years managing a large, complex enterprise network.
  • Leading large technical projects with demonstrated oral and written ability to communicate with team members and business leaders.
  •  Strong understanding of network routing, switching, wireless, firewalls and SDWAN Technologies. Manufacturers include (Cisco, Zscaler, Citrix, Palo Alto and F5).
  • CCNA or CCNP Certification, Active or Expired, and verifiable network project experience to match 5-10 years of active network leadership experience are highly desirable.
  • Experience with software defined networks (SDN) and cloud environments are a plus. Certifications in these areas desired. 
  • Experience with cloud-based telecom systems/technologies.
  • Managing and mentoring network engineers.
  • Architecting and designing large-scale networks.
  • Managing and maintaining Cisco Routers, Switches, Load Balancers and Firewalls.
  • Wireless networking technologies such as 802.11x in an enterprise environment.
  • Manage our internal clients and external clients in addressing escalations and client concerns.
  • Ability to be on call as needed, accommodate intermittent travel, and perform other duties as assigned.

job.title: Instructional Designer (AI-Forward Curriculum Design & Development)
job.description:
Company Description:

Shape the Future of Learning at Sutherland

At Sutherland, we don't just deliver exceptional customer and business solutions, we create learning experiences that transform careers, empower teams, and drive business success. As a global leader in digital transformation and business process solutions, we are passionate about innovation, continuous improvement, and developing world-class talent.

We're building our talent pipeline for an Instructional Designer who thrives on creativity, collaboration, and innovation. If you're passionate about turning complex concepts into engaging, impactful learning experiences and enjoy working with diverse stakeholders in a fast-paced environment, we'd love to connect with you.

Job Description:

We are looking for a highly creative and detail-oriented Instructional Designer to join our Learning Design and Experience (LDEx) team.

In this role, you will own the complete learning lifecycle, from analyzing training needs and designing curriculum to developing learning materials, facilitating train-the-trainer sessions, and evaluating training effectiveness. You will create engaging learning experiences across classroom, virtual, self-paced, and e-learning environments.

This is an AI-forward role, where you will leverage generative AI and other AI tools throughout the instructional design process to accelerate content analysis, curriculum design, content development, and revisions, while maintaining accountability for instructional quality, accuracy, and learner outcomes.

Beyond course development, you will help solve business and performance challenges through innovative learning solutions that deliver measurable results.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design end-to-end learning solutions using instructional design frameworks such as ADDIE, SAM, and Bloom's Taxonomy.
  • Analyze business requirements, review content, and identify knowledge and performance gaps.
  • Develop curriculum maps, learning paths, lesson plans, facilitator guides, learner materials, job aids, assessments, and e-learning content.
  • Create learning solutions for instructor-led, virtual instructor-led, self-paced, and digital learning environments.
  • Collaborate with subject matter experts (SMEs) to gather information, validate content, and ensure accuracy.
  • Utilize AI tools to support content analysis, storyboarding, scripting, drafting, and content refinement while ensuring quality and compliance standards.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to deliver learning projects on time and according to project requirements.
  • Conduct and support Train-the-Trainer (TTT) sessions to ensure successful implementation of learning programs.
  • Coordinate training readiness requirements, including tools, systems, technology, and learning materials needed before deployment.
  • Evaluate learning effectiveness using Kirkpatrick's Four Levels of Evaluation and recommend continuous improvements.
  • Lead learning initiatives that address organizational, operational, or performance challenges.
  • Manage multiple instructional design projects simultaneously while meeting quality and delivery expectations.

Qualifications:

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Education, Instructional Design, Learning & Development, Communications, Psychology, Business, or a related field. Equivalent education and experience may be considered.
  • At least 2 years of experience in Learning & Development, specifically focused on curriculum design, content development, and training delivery.
  • At least 1 year of experience in customer service, technical support, or a BPO environment.
  • Demonstrated experience applying instructional design methodologies such as ADDIE and SAM.
  • Strong understanding of adult learning principles and learning theories.
  • Experience creating training materials for one or more of the following:
    • Instructor-led training (ILT)
    • Virtual instructor-led training (VILT)
    • Self-paced learning
    • E-learning
  • Experience conducting learning evaluations and measuring training effectiveness.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven ability to collaborate with subject matter experts and diverse stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Experience using AI tools to improve instructional design and content development workflows.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience facilitating training programs, workshops, or train-the-trainer sessions.
  • Experience with e-learning authoring tools such as Rise 360, Storyline, or similar platforms.
  • Exposure to Learning Management Systems (LMS).
  • Familiarity with virtual learning platforms such as Microsoft Teams, Zoom, or Webex.
  • Experience supporting telecom, retail, customer service, technical support, or similar industries.
  • Knowledge of accessibility standards and inclusive learning design practices.
  • Experience working with multimedia content including audio, video, and graphics.
  • Professional certifications in Learning & Development, Instructional Design, ATD, CPTD, or related fields.

Additional Information:

What Success Looks Like

A successful candidate has experience taking a curriculum from initial analysis and design through development, implementation, train-the-trainer delivery, and learning evaluation. They can demonstrate how their learning solutions improved performance, solved business challenges, or enhanced learner outcomes.

Why Join Sutherland?

  • Be part of a high-performing Learning Design and Experience team.
  • Work on innovative, AI-powered learning initiatives.
  • Design learning solutions that drive real business impact.
  • Collaborate with industry experts and global stakeholders.
  • Grow your expertise in learning strategy, instructional design, and emerging AI technologies.

Sutherland is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

job.title: Lead-Research
job.description:
Job Description:

Job Description: Senior Professional: Credit Analyst

• The role is for a position in the Credit Research team, which supports many multibillion dollar asset managers worldwide.

• The team works as the virtual front-end analysts for clients, helping them find value in potential investment opportunities and thereafter, monitor the investment’s performance.

• The candidates are required to have a good understanding of one or many fixed income asset classes, such as High Yield Bonds, Leveraged Loans, and Structured Products.

• Ability to analyze primary and secondary deals in an efficient and time-bound manner and excellent written & verbal communication skills to interact with onsite analysts and portfolio managers are some prerequisites for the role.

 

Key Responsibilities

• Analyzing issuers via financial analysis, evaluating industry positioning, assessing business, management, and strategy, etc.

• Building and maintaining financial models (historical and forecasts) and other investment related infrastructure supporting our credit recommendations and investments across sectors

• Identifying investment catalysts and business risks, and forming an opinion on the said asset class/credits

• Authoring credit reports/memos, supporting and defending the recommendations in both verbal and written formats with portfolio managers

• Assessing the relative value of investment opportunities by interpreting risk–reward parameters, legal and capital structures, bond covenants, market drivers, and value of available alternatives

• Working with senior analysts to perform ongoing due diligence and monitor portfolio positions and key credits

• Keeping track of relevant news for the portfolio and analyzing potential impact

• Working well under pressure – must be able to remain calm and focused while multitasking in a fast-paced, unstructured, and dynamic work environment

• Team oriented/strong communication – must be able to work with people of diverse skills and personalities toward a common goal of effectively managing large portfolios

Qualifications:

Requirements

• MBA Finance from premier institutes/CFA/CA or equivalent

• Minimum 3 years of experience in credit evaluation and fixed income fundamental research

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Attention to detail and organizational skills

• Ability to work independently and should have critical reasoning skills

• Proficiency in using databases – Bloomberg, Microsoft Office, Syndication sites, and others

Additional Information:

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

job.description:

The Patient Scheduling Associate is responsible for scheduling, rescheduling and canceling exams for patients.   • The ability to handle interactions with a high degree of empathy and emotional intelligence.
  • Strong rapport building capabilities.
  • Keen eye for details with good probing and understanding skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with heavy focus on customer satisfaction and service.

job.title: Senior Manager, Strategy & Operations (Individual Contributor)
job.description:
Company Description:

Lead Enterprise Strategy. Influence Decisions. Drive Business Performance.

At Sutherland, we are looking for a highly strategic and analytical leader to join our team as a Senior Manager, Strategy & Operations. This is a high-impact individual contributor role responsible for driving complex business initiatives, influencing executive decision-making, and delivering insights that shape organizational strategy and operational excellence.

As a trusted partner to senior leaders, you will identify growth opportunities, solve critical business challenges, evaluate strategic investments, and lead transformative initiatives across the organization. You will leverage data, business acumen, and structured problem solving to deliver meaningful outcomes that improve performance, efficiency, and long-term value creation.

This role is ideal for professionals with backgrounds in management consulting, corporate strategy, investment banking, business transformation, or advanced analytics who thrive in fast-paced, highly visible environments.

Job Description:

*For Pooling Purposes*

What You'll Do

Lead High-Impact Strategic Initiatives

  • Own and drive enterprise-level projects that address critical business priorities and growth opportunities.
  • Partner with senior stakeholders to define objectives, develop execution plans, manage risks, and drive successful outcomes.
  • Evaluate strategic opportunities through business case development, scenario modeling, and financial analysis.

Shape Executive Decision-Making

  • Translate complex business problems into structured analyses and actionable recommendations.
  • Develop executive-ready presentations and insights that influence key business decisions.
  • Serve as a thought partner to leaders on operational, financial, and strategic priorities.

Drive Operational Excellence

  • Identify performance gaps, operational inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities across the business.
  • Recommend and support initiatives that optimize productivity, customer outcomes, and financial performance.
  • Establish measurement frameworks to monitor results and ensure sustainable impact.

Deliver Advanced Analytics & Business Insights

  • Build forecasting models, performance analyses, and strategic planning tools.
  • Design dashboards and reporting frameworks that provide visibility into key business drivers and organizational performance.
  • Conduct deep-dive analyses to support planning, budgeting, growth, and transformation initiatives.

Lead Ambiguous, Business-Critical Work

  • Tackle complex and time-sensitive business issues with limited direction.
  • Prioritize competing demands while maintaining focus on the highest-value opportunities.
  • Function as an independent strategic leader capable of influencing outcomes without direct authority.

Qualifications:

What We're Looking For

Strategic Thinking & Business Acumen

  • You quickly understand business models, market dynamics, operational drivers, and financial performance indicators, enabling you to identify opportunities and solve high-value business problems.

Executive Presence & Communication

  • You can distill complex analyses into concise, compelling insights and effectively communicate with senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

Structured Problem Solving

  • You bring a consulting-style approach to addressing ambiguity, breaking down complex challenges, and developing practical recommendations.

Results Orientation

  • You operate with a strong sense of ownership, balancing strategic thinking with execution discipline to deliver measurable business outcomes.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in an analytical discipline such as finance, economics, engineering, or mathematics.
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in Strategy, Operations, Management Consulting, Corporate Planning, Investment Banking, Business Transformation, Analytics, or related fields.
  • Experience leading enterprise-level strategic initiatives with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Strong financial, operational, and analytical modeling capabilities.
  • Advanced analytical and Excel modeling skills; SQL, Python, or R proficiency is a plus.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and data analysis tools.
  • Proven ability to influence senior leaders and drive outcomes in matrixed organizations.
  • Strong project management, prioritization, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with experience presenting to executive audiences.

Additional Information:

Why Join Sutherland?

This is an opportunity to work directly on high-priority business challenges, influence strategic decisions, and create lasting impact across the organization. You'll partner with senior leaders, solve complex problems, and help shape the future direction of a global organization while advancing your career in a highly visible strategic role.

If you're passionate about combining strategy, analytics, and business leadership to drive meaningful results, we encourage you to apply.

job.title: Senior Data Analytics Engineer (Manager Level | Individual Contributor)
job.description:
Company Description:

Transform Enterprise Data. Build the Future of Analytics.

Are you passionate about designing modern data platforms and solving complex analytics challenges at scale? We're looking for a Senior Data Analytics Engineer to lead the evolution of our next-generation data ecosystem.

This is a highly visible individual contributor role for a seasoned data professional who thrives at the intersection of data engineering, analytics, business intelligence, and cloud modernization. You will play a critical role in transforming legacy reporting environments into scalable, high-performance cloud-based solutions while partnering with global stakeholders to deliver insights that drive business decisions.

If you enjoy owning end-to-end data solutions, optimizing enterprise reporting, and building robust data pipelines that empower analytics and AI-driven initiatives, this opportunity is for you.

Job Description:

*For Pooling Purposes*

 

What You'll Do

Lead Enterprise Data Modernization Initiatives

  • Drive the migration of legacy reporting and analytics environments to modern cloud-based platforms.
  • Analyze existing BI models, SQL workloads, and reporting logic to identify optimization opportunities.
  • Convert complex business and reporting logic into scalable cloud-native data solutions.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy, and seamless transition through comprehensive validation and testing.

Design & Build Scalable Data Platforms

  • Develop, enhance, and maintain enterprise-grade data pipelines and data products.
  • Build efficient data transformation frameworks using modern analytics engineering practices.
  • Optimize data models, processing frameworks, and reporting performance.
  • Establish scalable solutions that support future analytics, reporting, and machine learning initiatives.

Partner with Business & Analytics Leaders

  • Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor on data architecture, reporting strategy, and platform capabilities.
  • Support strategic and ad hoc analytics requests through reliable, well-governed data assets.
  • Communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Drive Operational Excellence

  • Implement best practices for data governance, version control, documentation, and deployment.
  • Monitor platform performance and proactively identify optimization opportunities.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across analytics and data engineering functions.

Qualifications:

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, Business Intelligence, or Data Platform Development.
  • Strong expertise in SQL, including advanced query development, optimization, and stored procedure logic.
  • Experience working with Power BI, semantic models, and DAX-based reporting environments.
  • Hands-on experience with Spark, PySpark, Spark SQL, or similar big data technologies.
  • Proficiency in Python for data processing, automation, and analytics.
  • Experience using Git and modern software development practices.
  • Strong stakeholder management and requirements-gathering skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Databricks, Delta Lake, Databricks SQL, DLT Pipelines, and Unity Catalog.
  • Experience leading or contributing to cloud migration and data modernization initiatives.
  • Knowledge of modern data warehousing, lakehouse architecture, and analytics platforms.
  • Databricks, Azure, AWS, or related cloud certifications.
  • Experience supporting high-volume, customer-facing, or enterprise-scale operations.
  • Exposure to analytics, machine learning, or data science environments.

Additional Information:

Why Join Us?

Own High-Impact Data Initiatives

Take the lead on strategic data transformation projects that directly influence business performance and decision-making.

Work Directly with Global Leadership

Partner with senior leaders and cross-functional teams in a highly collaborative, fast-paced environment where your expertise is valued.

Shape a Modern Analytics Ecosystem

Play a foundational role in building scalable cloud-based data platforms that enable advanced analytics, AI, and future innovation.

Accelerate Your Career

Gain exposure to modern technologies, enterprise-scale datasets, and complex business challenges while expanding your leadership influence as a senior individual contributor.

job.title: Platform Engineer & Cloud Ops Engineer
job.description:
Company Description:

Sutherland is seeking a reliable person to join us as Platform and Cloud Engineer will be responsible to bridges the gap between IT operations and cybersecurity, focusing on the continuous protection of infrastructure and data through automation, monitoring, and proactive defense.

Job Description:

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Platform Architecture & Strategy (Senior-focused)

  • Lead the architecture and deployment of complex multi-cloud solutions (GCP/AWS), including networking, compute, storage, and multi-environment design.
  • Define platform standards and reusable patterns (e.g., Terraform modules, cluster blueprints).
  • Evaluate emerging cloud technologies to enhance cloud strategy and roadmap.
  • Drive cost optimization and FinOps practices, including right-sizing and governance.
  • Own platform reliability, scalability, capacity planning, and disaster recovery design.

Infrastructure Provisioning & Automation

  • Deploy, configure, and manage cloud infrastructure across GCP and AWS.
  • Write and maintain infrastructure as code (Terraform primary; CloudFormation/ARM where applicable).
  • Maintain multi-environment infrastructure consistency (dev, staging, prod).
  • Automate provisioning, configuration, and operational tasks to reduce manual toil.

Kubernetes & Container Platform

  • Design, operate, and support production-grade Kubernetes clusters (GKE preferred).
  • Manage upgrades, autoscaling, node pools, namespaces, and RBAC policies.
  • Own Helm/Kustomize standards for application deployment.
  • Support or manage service mesh (Istio) for traffic management, mTLS, observability, and security.
  • Define and promote golden paths for safe and consistent app deployment.

CI/CD, Monitoring & Operational Support

  • Build and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and application delivery.
  • Monitor platform health using Datadog — metrics, logs, traces, SLOs, and alerts.
  • Troubleshoot issues, support incident response, and lead post-incident reviews (senior).
  • Maintain runbooks and dashboards; lead or support on-call rotations.

Leadership & Collaboration (Senior-focused)

  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, set technical direction, and review designs.
  • Collaborate effectively with global, cross-functional, and on/offshore teams.
  • Communicate architecture decisions clearly to technical and business stakeholders.

TECH STACK

Required:

  • Cloud Platforms: GCP (Compute Engine, GKE, VPC, Storage, IAM, Load Balancing), AWS (EC2, EKS, VPC, S3, IAM)
  • Kubernetes: GKE architecture, upgrades, Helm/Kustomize, autoscaling, RBAC
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform (multi-environment, reusable modules, remote state)
  • CI/CD: GitLab pipeline development and support
  • Monitoring: Datadog (metrics, logs, traces, alerting, SLOs)
  • Service Mesh: Istio (traffic management, mTLS, observability)

Good to have:

  • GitOps tools (ArgoCD, Flux)
  • Cloud FinOps tooling and cost optimization experience
  • Scripting languages (Python, Go, Bash)
  • Vault, Packer, service catalogs, and self-service platforms
  • Experience in regulated environments (HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO 27001)

Qualifications:

REQUIREMENTS

Must have:

  • Platform Engineer: 3+ years in cloud infrastructure/platform or DevOps engineering.
  • Senior Platform Engineer: 8+ years, with leadership or architect-level responsibilities.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise with GCP and/or AWS cloud platforms.
  • Strong Kubernetes production experience, preferably GKE.
  • Expert-level Terraform skills with reusable modules and multi-env IaC.
  • Proven CI/CD automation experience at scale.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex cloud environment issues.
  • Collaborative teamwork mindset with clear communication skills.

Nice to have:

  • Certifications: Google Professional Cloud Architect, AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA).
  • Experience with GitOps and progressive delivery techniques.
  • Prior FinOps or cloud cost optimization role experience.
  • Scripting for automation and Linux system administration background.

HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED

  • Platform reliability: uptime and SLO achievement for shared services.
  • Automation coverage and manual toil reduction.
  • Adoption and enforcement of platform standards and self-service deployment paths.
  • Cloud cost efficiency achieved through optimization.
  • Timely and successful delivery of platform initiatives and projects.
  • Mean time to recovery (MTTR) for platform-impacting incidents.

Additional Information:

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

job.description:
Company Description:

Sutherland

Job Description:

Role summary

We are looking for a Performance Engineer to design and execute performance testing across web applications, BI workloads, and ETL/data models in a SAFe environment. The role requires strong hands-on experience with Apache JMeter, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, and Playwright for custom web, BI, and ETL performance scripting. Azure DevOps pipeline experience is required. Ability to learn quickly is essential. Hands-on use of GitHub Copilot is needed; familiarity with MCP is a plus.

 

Responsibilities

  • Design, execute, and analyze performance tests for web apps, BI reports/dashboards, and ETL/data models — JMeter (load, stress, soak, spike) for web, and custom Playwright/Python scripts for BI and ETL — and convert SLAs into measurable thresholds.
  • Validate ETL pipeline and data-model performance — job runtime, data volume handling, transformation throughput, and downstream reporting impact.
  • Assess BI performance — report/dashboard load times, query response, concurrent user load, and refresh/batch windows.
  • Integrate performance tests into Azure DevOps pipelines with automated quality gates, reporting, and release readiness checks.
  • Identify bottlenecks, publish clear findings, and work with development, QA, data, and operations teams.
  • Participate in SAFe ceremonies (PI Planning, Sprint Planning, System Demo, Inspect & Adapt) and deliver against iteration/PI goals.
  • Use GitHub Copilot (and MCP where available) to accelerate scripting, analysis, and documentation.

Qualifications:

Required skills

  • 4–8 years in performance engineering or test automation with a strong performance focus.
  • Strong JMeter experience: test plans, correlation, parameterization, assertions, distributed execution, and result analysis.
  • Playwright + JavaScript/TypeScript and Python for custom client-side, BI, and ETL performance scripting.
  • Experience performance-testing web applications, BI tools, and ETL/data models.
  • Azure DevOps experience: pipelines, CI/CD, test execution, and reporting.
  • Working knowledge of SAFe and ability to operate in Agile Release Trains.
  • Solid understanding of HTTP/APIs, data flows, and core performance metrics (latency, throughput, error rate, concurrency, job duration).
  • Practical experience with GitHub Copilot; familiarity with MCP is a plus.
  • Strong communication, root-cause analysis, and fast learning ability.

 

Nice to have

  • Deeper ETL / data pipeline background.
  • BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Cognos, or similar.
  • k6, Grafana, Datadog, Application Insights, or other observability tools.
  • Cloud experience (Azure preferred).

 

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

Additional Information:

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Job Description:

Job Summary

The Subject Matter Expert (SME) serves as the clinical and operational resource for the AO Clinical Claims Program. This role provides expertise on clinical claims processes, medical documentation review, disability management guidelines, quality standards, and client-specific policies and procedures. The SME supports production teams through coaching, training, case consultations, quality improvement initiatives, and process governance to ensure service excellence, compliance, and operational efficiency.

This is a dual-role position that requires the incumbent to function both as a Clinical Claims Associate and as a Subject Matter Expert simultaneously. In addition to providing expert guidance, floor support, coaching, and process expertise, the SME is expected to independently perform the same core clinical claims review and case management responsibilities as other team members. The SME will maintain an assigned production workload and is expected to meet established productivity, quality, accuracy, and compliance metrics while providing real-time support to the operations team.

The ideal candidate is a licensed US Registered Nurse (USRN) with strong clinical claims experience, exceptional analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with operations leaders, quality teams, trainers, and client stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical and Operational Expertise

  • Serve as the primary clinical subject matter expert for disability and clinical claims operations.
  • Interpret and apply client-specific guidelines, medical policies, and standard operating procedures.
  • Review complex cases and provide recommendations to associates and leadership teams.
  • Support accurate evaluation and documentation of clinical claims based on medical evidence and established protocols.
  • Ensure consistency in claims handling and decision-support processes.
  • Perform end-to-end clinical claims review, assessment, and documentation activities consistent with the responsibilities of a Clinical Claims Associate/Analyst.
  • Maintain an assigned production workload and achieve established productivity, quality, accuracy, and compliance targets.
  • Balance individual case processing responsibilities with SME support, coaching, and escalation management activities.
  • Demonstrate best practices in claims handling, clinical documentation review, and decision-making while serving as a role model for the team.

Team Support and Coaching

  • Provide floor support and real-time assistance to agents and analysts.
  • Conduct case reviews, side-by-side coaching, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
  • Identify performance gaps and recommend developmental interventions.
  • Act as the escalation point for process-related and clinical questions.
  • Provide support to associates while actively managing a personal caseload and production responsibilities.
  • Serve as a role model by demonstrating effective claims processing techniques, adherence to operational standards, and strong performance outcomes.

Training and Knowledge Management

  • Facilitate refresher sessions and uptraining programs.
  • Assist Training and Operations teams in creating and updating process documentation.
  • Support onboarding activities for new hires.
  • Maintain knowledge repositories and ensure process updates are communicated effectively.

Quality and Compliance

  • Partner with Quality Assurance teams to drive accuracy and compliance metrics.
  • Participate in calibration sessions to ensure consistent interpretation of clinical policies.
  • Monitor regulatory and client-driven changes impacting operations.
  • Support audit activities and corrective action plans.
  • Lead by example by consistently meeting quality and compliance standards in both production and SME-related responsibilities.

Process Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve workflow efficiency and claim review processes.
  • Analyze trends, defects, and operational challenges.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders on continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Assist in implementing process enhancements and best practices.

Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with Operations Managers, Team Managers, Quality Analysts, Trainers, Workforce, and Client Partners.
  • Participate in client meetings and discussions when requested.
  • Provide insights and recommendations based on operational and clinical findings.

Qualifications:

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Active and unrestricted US Registered Nurse (USRN) license.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Nursing (BSN).
  • Minimum 2-3 years of US healthcare experience in one or a combination of the following:
    • Disability Claims
    • Clinical Claims Review
    • Utilization Management (UM)
    • Case Management (CM)
    • Workers' Compensation
    • Medical Review
    • Insurance Claims Operations
  • Extensive knowledge of medical terminology, disease processes, treatment protocols, and clinical documentation review.
  • Strong understanding of disability management and insurance claims processes.
  • Experience working in a healthcare BPO/shared services environment preferred.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
  • Willing to work in a shifting schedule and support business requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively balance individual production responsibilities with Subject Matter Expert support functions.
  • Proven experience maintaining performance metrics while providing coaching, floor support, guidance, and operational assistance to peers.
  • Strong time management, prioritization, multitasking, and stakeholder management skills in a fast-paced clinical operations environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Disability Claims, Group Benefits, or similar insurance accounts.
  • Lean Six Sigma or Continuous Improvement exposure.
  • Experience facilitating training and coaching sessions.
  • Background in quality auditing and process calibration.
  • Leadership or project management experience.

Additional Information:

Internal Qualifications:

  • Must have Annual PDP score of Exceeds Expectations (4) or Outstanding (5)
  • Tenure of at least 12 months on the current role
  • No Active DA 

Role Clarification

Important: This is not a dedicated support-only SME position. The selected candidate will be expected to perform the same core clinical claims processing and case review functions as other team members while simultaneously serving as the team's Subject Matter Expert. Success in this role requires balancing production targets, quality expectations, coaching responsibilities, escalation support, and operational excellence.

job.title: Lead - SD Management
job.description:
Company Description:

Sutherland is looking for a self-motivated, team-oriented and career-oriented person to join us as a  Customer Support & Sales - Chat Consultant. We are a group of driven and hard-working individuals. If you are looking to build a fulfilling career and are confident you have the skills and experience to help us succeed, we want to work with you! 

Job Description:

Position Purpose

Drives the daily operational performance and real-time execution of the helpdesk team. This role balances workforce monitoring, service level compliance, and active agent coaching to foster a high-performance service environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Queue & Service Level Management: Actively monitor real-time call queues, abandon rates, and ticket backlogs to dynamically shift resources and secure daily SLA targets.
  • Performance Coaching: Conduct structured weekly call monitoring audits and monthly performance feedback sessions for L1 and L2 agents to improve quality and FCR.
  • Operational Escalations: Act as the first formal escalation point for critical operational challenges, vendor disconnects, or highly dissatisfied employees.
  • Quality Assurance: Partner with the Quality Analyst to review team performance metrics, identify training gaps, and implement targeted remediation plans.
  • Team Engagement: Manage front-line team culture, driving initiatives to boost employee engagement, prevent burnout, and reduce team attrition.

Experience in Years

  • Total Experience: 5 to 7 years of professional experience in customer management/operations.
  • Domain-Specific Experience: Minimum 2 years of direct people management or supervisory experience leading a team within a voice-capable contact centre or an HR Shared Services hub.

Ideal Candidate Experience & Profile

  • People Developer: The ideal candidate is an inspiring front-line captain who has successfully managed groups of 10–15 agents, focusing heavily on operational metrics without losing sight of human morale.
  • Metric-Driven Floor Manager: They are hyper-aware of real-time dashboards. They know exactly when a spike in call volume requires altering break schedules or pulling an agent out of an offline task.
  • Constructive Coach: They have mastered the art of delivering direct, actionable performance feedback that motivates underperforming agents rather than discouraging them.
  • Process Fixer: They don't just patch problems; they proactively identify when a high volume of L1 transfers means the team needs an updated SOP or a refresher training session.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Operational Literacy: Solid understanding of contact center dynamics and core metrics (e.g., SLA, Occupancy, Shrinkage, CSAT, ASA).
  • Communication: Powerful interpersonal skills; able to deliver constructive, actionable feedback to team members and articulate operational issues clearly to management.
  • Problem Solving: Ability to make quick, data-driven decisions under pressure to resolve real-time staffing or queue bottlenecks.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.

“Sutherland never requests payment or favors in exchange for job opportunities. Please report suspicious activity immediately to “TAHelpdesk@Sutherlandglobal.com”

Qualifications:

Graduation (preferably from HR stream)

  • Drive partner-led pipeline and joint account planning.

  • Strong commercial, negotiation and executive communication skills.
  • Experience with AWS, GCP, Oracle and/or Microsoft partner ecosystems.
  • Experience working effectively with offshore solutioning and delivery organizations.

Preferred Experience

Infrastructure Managed Services | Cloud Operations | Cybersecurity / Cyber Resilience | IT Resilience | SRE / AIOps | AI Infrastructure / AI Operations | Application Operations | Global SI / IT Services

Additional Information:

  • Strategic accounts personally opened or significantly expanded.
  • Opportunities created and shaped before formal RFP.
  • Large managed-services deals personally shaped and won.
  • CIO / CTO / CISO relationships personally developed.

A senior Infrastructure + Security business leader who can open the account, create the opportunity, shape the proposition and close strategic business.

job.title: Subject Matter Expert (SME) - USRN - Taguig
job.description:
Company Description:

About Sutherland

Artificial Intelligence. Automation. Cloud engineering. Advanced analytics. For business leaders, these are key factors of success. For us, they’re our core expertise.
We work with iconic brands worldwide. We bring them a unique value proposition through market-leading technology and business process excellence.

We’ve created over 200 unique inventions under several patents across AI and other critical technologies. Leveraging our advanced products and platforms, we drive digital transformation, optimize critical business operations, reinvent experiences, and pioneer new solutions, all provided through a seamless “as a service” model.

For each company, we provide new keys for their businesses, the people they work with, and the customers they serve. We tailor proven and rapid formulas, to fit their unique DNA. We bring together human expertise and artificial intelligence to develop digital chemistry. This unlocks new possibilities, transformative outcomes and enduring relationships.

Sutherland
Unlocking digital performance. Delivering measurable results.

 

Job Description:

Job Summary

The Subject Matter Expert (SME) serves as the clinical and operational resource for the AO Clinical Claims Program. This role provides expertise on clinical claims processes, medical documentation review, disability management guidelines, quality standards, and client-specific policies and procedures. The SME supports production teams through coaching, training, case consultations, quality improvement initiatives, and process governance to ensure service excellence, compliance, and operational efficiency.

This is a dual-role position that requires the incumbent to function both as a Clinical Claims Associate and as a Subject Matter Expert simultaneously. In addition to providing expert guidance, floor support, coaching, and process expertise, the SME is expected to independently perform the same core clinical claims review and case management responsibilities as other team members. The SME will maintain an assigned production workload and is expected to meet established productivity, quality, accuracy, and compliance metrics while providing real-time support to the operations team.

The ideal candidate is a licensed US Registered Nurse (USRN) with strong clinical claims experience, exceptional analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with operations leaders, quality teams, trainers, and client stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical and Operational Expertise

  • Serve as the primary clinical subject matter expert for disability and clinical claims operations.
  • Interpret and apply client-specific guidelines, medical policies, and standard operating procedures.
  • Review complex cases and provide recommendations to associates and leadership teams.
  • Support accurate evaluation and documentation of clinical claims based on medical evidence and established protocols.
  • Ensure consistency in claims handling and decision-support processes.
  • Perform end-to-end clinical claims review, assessment, and documentation activities consistent with the responsibilities of a Clinical Claims Associate/Analyst.
  • Maintain an assigned production workload and achieve established productivity, quality, accuracy, and compliance targets.
  • Balance individual case processing responsibilities with SME support, coaching, and escalation management activities.
  • Demonstrate best practices in claims handling, clinical documentation review, and decision-making while serving as a role model for the team.

Team Support and Coaching

  • Provide floor support and real-time assistance to agents and analysts.
  • Conduct case reviews, side-by-side coaching, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
  • Identify performance gaps and recommend developmental interventions.
  • Act as the escalation point for process-related and clinical questions.
  • Provide support to associates while actively managing a personal caseload and production responsibilities.
  • Serve as a role model by demonstrating effective claims processing techniques, adherence to operational standards, and strong performance outcomes.

Training and Knowledge Management

  • Facilitate refresher sessions and uptraining programs.
  • Assist Training and Operations teams in creating and updating process documentation.
  • Support onboarding activities for new hires.
  • Maintain knowledge repositories and ensure process updates are communicated effectively.

Quality and Compliance

  • Partner with Quality Assurance teams to drive accuracy and compliance metrics.
  • Participate in calibration sessions to ensure consistent interpretation of clinical policies.
  • Monitor regulatory and client-driven changes impacting operations.
  • Support audit activities and corrective action plans.
  • Lead by example by consistently meeting quality and compliance standards in both production and SME-related responsibilities.

Process Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve workflow efficiency and claim review processes.
  • Analyze trends, defects, and operational challenges.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders on continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Assist in implementing process enhancements and best practices.

Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with Operations Managers, Team Managers, Quality Analysts, Trainers, Workforce, and Client Partners.
  • Participate in client meetings and discussions when requested.
  • Provide insights and recommendations based on operational and clinical findings.

Qualifications:

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Active and unrestricted US Registered Nurse (USRN) license.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Nursing (BSN).
  • Minimum 2-3 years of US healthcare experience in one or a combination of the following:
    • Disability Claims
    • Clinical Claims Review
    • Utilization Management (UM)
    • Case Management (CM)
    • Workers' Compensation
    • Medical Review
    • Insurance Claims Operations
  • Extensive knowledge of medical terminology, disease processes, treatment protocols, and clinical documentation review.
  • Strong understanding of disability management and insurance claims processes.
  • Experience working in a healthcare BPO/shared services environment preferred.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
  • Willing to work in a shifting schedule and support business requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively balance individual production responsibilities with Subject Matter Expert support functions.
  • Proven experience maintaining performance metrics while providing coaching, floor support, guidance, and operational assistance to peers.
  • Strong time management, prioritization, multitasking, and stakeholder management skills in a fast-paced clinical operations environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Disability Claims, Group Benefits, or similar insurance accounts.
  • Lean Six Sigma or Continuous Improvement exposure.
  • Experience facilitating training and coaching sessions.
  • Background in quality auditing and process calibration.
  • Leadership or project management experience.

Additional Information:

Internal Qualifications:

  • Must have Annual PDP score of Exceeds Expectations (4) or Outstanding (5)
  • Tenure of at least 12 months on the current role
  • No Active DA 

Role Clarification

Important: This is not a dedicated support-only SME position. The selected candidate will be expected to perform the same core clinical claims processing and case review functions as other team members while simultaneously serving as the team's Subject Matter Expert. Success in this role requires balancing production targets, quality expectations, coaching responsibilities, escalation support, and operational excellence.

job.title: Facilities Engineer (entry level) - Pili CamSur
job.description:
Company Description:

Sutherland is seeking a reliable and attentive person to join us as a Facilities & Property Management Associate. We are a group of supportive and hardworking individuals. If you are looking to build a fulfilling career and are confident you have the skills and experience to help us succeed, we want to work with you!

Job Description:

Facilities Operations & Maintenance

  • Manage day-to-day facilities operations including leasehold improvements, equipment upkeep, and site maintenance
  • Ensure functionality and readiness of all office equipment and physical workspace
  • Conduct regular facility inspections and implement preventive and corrective maintenance programs
  • Supervise contractors for general repairs, pest control, and scheduled maintenance activities
  • Oversee workspace readiness including seat assignments, relocations, and partition installations in coordination with Capacity Planning
  • Monitor utilities consumption (electricity and water) and maintain accurate tracking reports
  • Ensure Asset Maintenance Contracts (AMC) are updated and all equipment (UPS, AC units, gensets) are regularly serviced
  • Maintain organized documentation of service reports, contracts, and compliance records
  • Support implementation of health and safety standards across the site

Ticketing & Service Management

  • Manage and resolve facility-related requests via ticketing systems within agreed SLAs
  • Monitor ticket queues to avoid backlog and aging issues
  • Provide timely updates and coordinate approvals with stakeholders

Project & Site Management

  • Support project teams in site build-outs, renovations, and rehabilitation activities
  • Coordinate project schedules and maintenance work with internal departments to minimize disruption
  • Participate in weekly seat planning and operational meetings

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

  • Respond to internal requests for office setup (meetings, training, onboarding sessions)
  • Collaborate with Capacity Planning for workspace and equipment requirements
  • Coordinate with building administration on facility concerns and maintenance issues
  • Liaise with vendors, lessors, and government agencies (e.g., PEZA, local authorities) to ensure compliance

Training & Development

  • Participate in continuous learning and development programs to enhance technical and operational competencies

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering
    • Required: Licensed Mechanical or Electrical Engineer
  • Willingness to work extended hours or flexible schedules, as needed
  • Must be willing to report on-site at Sutherland Pili CamSur, IT Park, Provincial Capitol Complex, Cadlan, Pili, Camarines Sur, 4418
  • Knowledgeable in civil and structural building construction, including interior and exterior works
  • Proficient in designing and computing Electrical and Mechanical plans
  • Hands-on knowledge in the operation and maintenance of generator sets, UPS systems, and other critical facility equipment
  • Capable of evaluating vendor preventive maintenance reports and recommending appropriate action plans
  • Basic project management skills with experience supporting site build-outs, renovations, and maintenance projects
  • Familiarity with facilities operations, including utilities monitoring, equipment maintenance, and workplace management
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and recommend improvements
  • Excellent attention to detail with strong organizational and documentation skills
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills; able to communicate in a clear, professional, and constructive manner
  • Demonstrates professionalism, confidentiality, and high ethical standards at all times
  • Strong customer service orientation with the ability to build relationships with internal and external stakeholders
  • Proactive team player with the ability to develop trust and collaborate effectively across teams
  • Highly adaptable and able to quickly adjust to changing priorities and work environments
  • Strong work ethic, integrity, flexibility, and leadership or coaching capabilities

Additional Information:

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

job.description:
Company Description:

About Sutherland: 

Artificial Intelligence. Automation. Cloud engineering. Advanced analytics. For business leaders, these are key factors of success. For us, they’re our core expertise.

Sutherland

Unlocking digital performance. Delivering measurable results

Job Description:

About the Role

Connect is one of the premier and fastest selling products at Sutherland, providing a full omni-channel, Contact Center as a Service solution for our clients. We are looking for an experienced Sr. Product Delivery Manager to join our growing team and drive the delivery of Connect products and services through the full development lifecycle.

The Product Owner sets product vision and roadmap direction. From that point the product is yours through delivery: shaping requirements into a solution that can actually be built, making the trade-off calls that decide what ships and what defers, driving the build, running QA and UAT, and getting the product released and ready to deploy. Client deployments are run by the project management organization, and you support them as the product authority. At times this team carries the deployment directly. This is not a coordination role. You are expected to apply product judgment on scope, design, and release readiness, and to carry the professional standing that earns you the respect of engineering, operations, and clients.

Real contact center expertise is essential. You will make product and delivery decisions daily on omni-channel routing, telephony, agent desktop, recording, reporting, and integration behavior. You need to know how a contact center runs well enough to recognize when a design will not hold up against real routing, peak volume, or a failover, and to make that case to engineering. Candidates must have delivered products or capabilities on a contact center platform.

You will join a team of Product Delivery Managers reporting to the Head of Product Delivery. Delivery work is shared across the team, so you will coordinate with your peers on dependencies, shared components, release trains, and release order, and help shape the standards the team works to. The role has no direct reports and depends on working effectively across architecture, engineering, QA, project management, implementation, and operations. This is a remote position based in the United States. The team works US business hours, primarily Eastern Time and extending to Pacific Time, and that must be your normal business day. This role cannot be worked as an offset shift from another region.

 

Key Responsibilities

Requirements Intake & Delivery Planning

  • Take product direction and priorities from the Head of Product Delivery and shape them into a delivery plan, including where the approach has to change to hold up in a live contact center.
  • Review requirements for clarity, completeness, testability, and feasibility. Take gaps, conflicts, and ambiguities back to the Head of Product Delivery and resolve them before work starts.
  • Break requirements into epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria that development and QA can work from.
  • Size and phase the work with engineering, set milestones and release targets, and identify dependencies, assumptions, and risks up front.
  • Coordinate with peer Product Delivery Managers on cross-product dependencies, shared components, and release order.
  • Separate client-specific configuration from core product capability, and flag anything that would change product direction for the Head of Product Delivery.
  • Escalate scope, capacity, or timeline conflicts to the Head of Product Delivery with options and a recommendation.

Design & Build

  • Own execution for your assigned products and features: scope, schedule, quality, and dependencies.
  • Work with solution architects and engineering leads to turn approved requirements into functional and technical designs, and test those designs against real routing, agent workflow, telephony, recording, and reporting behavior.
  • Act as product owner for the scrum team: maintain the backlog, clarify requirements, clear roadblocks, and accept completed work against the acceptance criteria.
  • Maintain accurate delivery status and raise risks, issues, and blockers early with a recommended course of action.
  • Make the scope calls inside a release: decide what ships and what defers based on defect risk, client impact, and production readiness.

QA, UAT & Release

  • Set test scope, strategy, and entry and exit criteria with QA, and confirm coverage against the documented requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Run defect triage and prioritization, push fixes and retests, and track defect trends against the release date.
  • Plan and lead user acceptance testing with internal and client stakeholders and obtain UAT sign-off.
  • Own the product release plan with engineering and operations, including environment readiness, rollback, and go / no go criteria for putting the product into service.
  • Give the Head of Product Delivery a go or no go recommendation supported by test results, open defects, and known risk.
  • Support the project management organization on client deployments as the product authority, and lead the deployment directly when this team carries it.

Release & Deployment Support

  • Produce the release package the deployment teams work from: release notes, configuration and technical documentation, runbooks, and internal readiness sessions.
  • Hand the product to operations, support, and the project management organization with escalation paths, known issues, and supportability documentation.
  • Act as the product escalation point once deployments are in the field: answer design and configuration questions, and own resolution of product defects found during rollout.
  • Stay engaged through hypercare on the product side, working with operations and support until production issues and post-release fixes are closed.
  • Turn production performance, defect trends, and delivery lessons into roadmap direction and bring it back to the Head of Product Delivery, and manage delivery of enhancements, maintenance releases, and version upgrades.

Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of hands-on contact center technology experience across voice, email, chat, SMS, social, web, video, and mobile.
  • 5+ years in product delivery, delivery management, product ownership, or technical project management for software products.
  • Availability to work USA EST or CST working hours
  • Hands-on delivery or configuration experience on at least one major contact center platform: Genesys, NICE, Cisco, Avaya, Five9, Amazon Connect, or Twilio Flex.
  • Working knowledge of how contact center components fit together: ACD and routing, IVR and self-service, CTI and agent desktop, dialer and outbound, call recording, screen recording, quality management, workforce management, and reporting.
  • Experience with contact center integrations: CRM and ticketing, screen pop, APIs and webhooks, SIP and carrier connectivity, and reporting feeds.
  • Experience planning and executing production releases into live 24x7 customer-facing environments, including go-live, rollback, and go / no go decisions.
  • Working knowledge of QA practice: test strategy, defect triage and prioritization, release criteria, and UAT.
  • Experience with Agile, Scrum, or hybrid delivery, using Jira or Azure DevOps.
  • Familiarity with the regulatory environment contact centers operate in, including PCI-DSS, TCPA, GDPR, HIPAA, and call recording consent.
  • Prior experience reviewing and analyzing contact center solutions, and recommending design improvements and roadmap direction.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including reporting to leadership and translating between business and technical audiences.
  • Sound judgment under pressure: able to weigh incomplete information and make a defensible call rather than escalate every decision.
  • Strong analytical skills and the discipline to track dependencies, defects, and commitments without losing sight of the release goal.
  • Takes accountability for delivery outcomes and product quality.
  • Effective in a fast-paced hybrid Agile environment with shifting priorities.
  • Builds durable working relationships across engineering, QA, operations, and client teams.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Delivery experience in a BPO or outsourced contact center environment, with multi-client and multi-site deployments.
  • Experience delivering AI and automation into a contact center: virtual agents, conversational IVR, agent assist, speech and text analytics, or intelligent routing.
  • Experience delivering CCaaS capabilities in a multi-tenant, cloud-native environment.
  • Prior time inside contact center operations, such as a supervisor or workforce role, alongside technology delivery.
  • Relevant certifications such as CSPO, CSM, SAFe, or PMP, or a platform-specific contact center certification.

Job Description:

The Medical Coding Team Lead supports the day-to-day operations of the Medical Coding Department by serving as a resource to coding staff and partnering closely with Coding Managers to ensure operational efficiency, coding quality, productivity, and compliance. This position provides technical guidance, assists with workflow coordination, monitors work queues and performance metrics, resolves routine operational issues, and supports training and quality initiatives. The Team Lead serves as a liaison between coding staff and management, helping to maintain consistent operations while promoting a collaborative and high-performing work environment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities: 

  • Provide day-to-day operational support to Coding Managers without assuming direct supervisory responsibility; to include workflow coordination in alignment with operational priorities. 
  • Monitor coding work queues, assign or redistribute workloads as directed, and escalate issues that may impact productivity or turnaround times. 
  • Serve as resource for coders regarding routine coding questions, workflow concerns, and operational issues. 
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to coding staff while promoting coding accuracy and compliance. 
  • Reinforce departmental policies, procedures, and quality standards. 
  • Assist Coding Managers in monitoring coding productivity, quality, and turnaround time metrics. 
  • Support employee development through coaching, knowledge sharing, and education. 
  • Escalate employee performance concerns, workflow barriers, or compliance issues to Coding Managers as appropriate. 
  • Assist with providing ongoing education related to departmental procedures. 
  • Assist with ensuring compliance with ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, CPT, HCPCS Level II, Medicare, Medicaid, commercial payer, and organizational coding guidelines. 
  • Support departmental projects, workflow improvements, system implementations, and process optimization initiatives. 
  • Stay current with coding regulations, payer requirements, CMS guidance, and industry best practices. 
  • Maintain confidentiality of protected health information (PHI) in accordance with HIPAA regulations. 

Qualifications:

Required Qualifications: 

  • Minimum of 5 years of progressive medical coding experience. 
  • Previous experience serving as a senior coder, lead coder, trainer, mentor, or similar role preferred. 
  • Current coding certification such as: 
  • Certified Professional Coder (CPC) 
  • Certified Coding Specialist (CCS) 
  • Certified Inpatient Coder (CIC) 
  • Certified Outpatient Coder (COC) 
  • Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT) 
  • or Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA) preferred 
  • Advanced knowledge of ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, CPT, and HCPCS Level II coding systems. 
  • Thorough understanding of CMS regulations, National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI), Official Coding Guidelines, and payer-specific requirements. 
  • Experience using electronic health records (EHR) and coding software.

Job Description:

The Medical Coding Auditor is responsible for keeping Sutherland coders in compliance by reviewing medical records and coding practices to ensure accurate assignment of ICD-10-CM, CPT, and HCPCS Level II codes in compliance with federal, state, payer, and organizational guidelines. This role evaluates coding accuracy, identifies documentation deficiencies, conducts audits, provides education to coding staff and providers, and supports revenue cycle integrity while minimizing compliance risk.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Perform retrospective, concurrent, and prospective coding audits for inpatient, outpatient, physician, and/or specialty services.
  • Review medical documentation to validate the accuracy and completeness of assigned diagnosis and procedure codes.
  • Ensure compliance with ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, CPT, HCPCS Level II, Medicare, Medicaid, commercial payer, and regulatory guidelines.
  • Identify coding errors, documentation gaps, and reimbursement opportunities.
  • Prepare detailed audit reports outlining findings, trends, recommendations, and corrective actions.
  • Provide one-on-one and group education to coders, providers, and clinical staff regarding coding updates, documentation improvement, and compliance requirements.
  • Monitor coding quality metrics and develop action plans to improve coding accuracy and consistency.
  • Stay current on coding regulations, Official Coding Guidelines, CMS regulations, payer policies, and industry best practices.
  • Assist with internal and external audits, payer reviews, and regulatory investigations.
  • Maintain confidentiality of protected health information (PHI) in accordance with HIPAA regulations.
  • Participate in policy development, process improvement initiatives, and coding education programs.
  • Track audit results and identify recurring trends to support continuous quality improvement.

Qualifications:

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 3-5 years of medical coding experience in a healthcare setting.
  • Minimum of 2 years of coding audit or quality review experience preferred.
  • Current coding certification such as:
  • Certified Professional Coder (CPC)
  • Certified Professional Medical Auditor (CPMA)
  • Certified Coding Specialist (CCS)
  • Certified Inpatient Coder (CIC)
  • Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT) or
  • Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA) preferred
  • Extensive knowledge of ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, CPT, and HCPCS coding systems.
  • Strong understanding of CMS regulations, National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI), Official Coding Guidelines, and payer-specific policies.
  • Experience with electronic health records (EHR) and encoder software.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Exceptional analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • Strong knowledge of healthcare reimbursement methodologies.
  • Ability to interpret complex clinical documentation.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational abilities.
  • Ability to maintain objectivity while providing constructive feedback.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and coding/audit software.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Job Description:

The IT Support Specialist (Tier 1) is the first point of contact for end-users seeking technical assistance. This role will monitor, operate, troubleshoot, and resolve Level 1 technical issues remotely, ensuring staff and scholars have the tools they need to succeed. Utilizing ServiceNow and other remote diagnostic tools, this individual will perform a broad range of customer assistance, software deployment, remote equipment troubleshooting, and access management.


COMPETENCIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Ticket Management: Triage, accurately log, and respond to inbound support requests via ServiceNow, ensuring SLAs are met for first-call resolution and response times.
Remote Technical Support: Provide first-line remote support for personal computer hardware, software, and specialized technology; escalate complex Level 2/Level 3 issues to appropriate internal teams.
System Health & Maintenance: Conduct routine remote health checks and audits on enterprise systems to proactively ensure software and security compliance.
Device Configuration: Assist in the remote setup, zero-touch provisioning, and configuration of laptops and peripherals for onboarding employees.
Software Management: Push remote software installations, updates, and repairs using endpoint management tools.
Asset Management: Track and maintain accurate records of distributed hardware and software licenses within ServiceNow's CMDB/Asset Management modules.
Knowledge Management: Develop, test, and publish user documentation, how-to guides, and Knowledge Base (KB) articles within ServiceNow.
Vendor Liaison: Communicate with external hardware and software vendors to resolve ongoing remote issues.
 

Qualifications:

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE
2+ years of direct experience in enterprise-level IT customer and application support (remote support experience highly preferred).
ITSM Proficiency: Hands-on experience using ServiceNow for ticket management, asset tracking, and knowledge base utilization.
Core Systems: Experience supporting and troubleshooting core enterprise applications, including Okta, Google Workplace, Workday, and JAMF.
Networking: Foundational knowledge of network protocols and standards, including remote troubleshooting for Macs, Chromebooks, and peripherals
Communication: Excellent oral and written interpersonal communication skills, with a focus on delivering empathetic and patient customer service over the phone or chat.
Project Skills: Exposure to project-based work structures and IT project lifecycle models.
Work Ethic: Highly self-motivated and directed, with keen attention to detail and the ability to prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment.
Team Player: Experience working collaboratively in a distributed, team-oriented environment.

Additional Information:

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the offshore ICM Practice and COE capability organization.
  • Own technical strategy for strategic pursuits and RFPs.

  • Assign and govern Named Solution Owners for qualified opportunities.

  • Measurable improvements in delivery quality, productivity or reuse.

Ideal Candidate Profile

A senior technology-services leader who can solve, win, build capability, govern delivery and convert delivery expertise into scalable IP.
